Ha heb' icha chi' sk'ulej, ichato a k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh slo heb'. Juwinakel spensar heb', satnak heb', manh ol yal skolan sb'a heb'. Manh na'anok yalan heb' icha tik: Ha tas b'ob'il yuj in k'ab' tik, nab'a esnhej, manh xchiok heb'.
Ex israel, yinhtilal Jacob, naekkoti to in chekab' ex, a in in b'onak ex yik tzex och in chekab'ok, mokab' in b'at satk'olal eyu'uj.
Ha in ix in satel he palta'il icha satem yal ak'wal. Ix in satel he mul icha wal tz'aj satem asun. Kotanhekxi t'ayin, yujto ix ex in kolo', xchi Jehová.

Ha satchanh, elokab' yaw sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yuj tas ix sk'ulej Jehová. Ha niwak jul t'a sat lu'um tik, awajokab'i. Ha lum niwak witz yet' lum tzalkixtak, b'itanokab' lu'um t'a tzalajk'olal yujto ix sch'ox stzikikial Jehová ayik ix skolan heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob.

Ha Jehová ko Kolumal tz'alan icha tik: Ha in ton Jehová in, ix ex in b'o'o ayik manto ex alji, a in in b'onak masanil tastak. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha'anh, wak'annakpaxkan em lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, ¿tom ay junokxo mach kolwajnak wet'ok?
Ha in tzin tenek' tas syal heb' ajchum, tzin juanpaxb'at spensar heb' naumel lolonel. Swak'an somchajel spensar heb' aj pensar, skistalaxkan heb' wu'uj.

Palta a in swak'elk'och tas syal heb' in chekab', yik wach' tz'ajelk'och tas syal heb' chi'. Ha in swala' to a Jerusalén ol kajnajxok, haxo juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ol b'ochajxok t'a yet'tal b'aj juwinakel chi'.
Ha in syal walan t'a ha' mar to stup ha'. Masanil yoktak ha' tz'eli, swak' tupok.

Ha in swal t'a winhaj Ciro icha tik: Ach Ciro, a ach ayach och yilumalok in chonhab'. Ha ach ol a b'o masanil tas tzin nib'ej. Ol halan t'a Jerusalén: Ol ach b'ochajxik'eok, ol ak'chajxiem yich templo, xa chi, xin chi t'a winh, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová ix sik'anoch winhaj Ciro reyal. Ha ol kuchb'an winh yik ol yak'an ganar juntzanh niwak nación winh, ol yik'anek' yopisio juntzanh heb' winh sreyal nación chi' winh. Ha Jehová chi' ol ak'an jakchaj spuerta'il juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a winhaj Ciro chi', malaj junok mach ol yal smakani. Yuj chi' syalan Jehová icha tik:
Ha in wal ol in b'ab'laj t'a ichanh, ol wak' panhanb'ok lum lum cha'anh. Ol in mak'poj juntzanh puerta nab'a bronce, ol in b'ijchitanb'at k'e'en hierro ayoch yijchulok.
Ha juntzanh b'eyumal k'ub'aneli yet' tas elk'altak yaji, ol wak' t'ayach, yik wach' tzojtakejeli to a in ton Jehová in, sDiosal in Israel, ix ach wawtej t'a a b'i.
Yuj wal to tzin xajanej heb' yinhtilal winh in chekab' aj Jacob, haton chonhab' Israel sik'b'ilel wu'uj, yuj chi' tzach wawtej yik tzach b'inaji wach'chom manh in ojtakok.
Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junokxo. Malaj junokxo Dios. Ha innhej toni. Wach'chom manh in ojtakok, palta a in ol wak' ip
yik wach' syojtakejel masanil anima ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, masanto b'aj tz'em k'u to Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junokxo.
Ha in in b'onak sakil k'inal yet' k'ik' k'inal. Ha in swak' junk'olal, swak'anpax yahelal. Ha in ton Jehová in tzin k'ulej juntzanh tik.

Ha in ol wak'kot tojolal t'a satcha'anh, icha yem yal ak'wal, icha yem nhab' t'a kal asun, ol scha'an lum lum tik yemuli. Cheklajokab' kolnab'il icha sat te awb'en te', ayokab' tojolal icha tz'aj spojel te' xumak. Ha in ol wak' ujok jun tik, xchi Jehová.

Ha mach syak' owal yet' mach b'ojinak, lajan wal icha lum tz'akb'il lum k'un spoji. Tokwal syal lum tz'akb'il lum chi' t'a mach stz'akani ¿Tas tza k'ulej? Ha ach tik, manh ojtakok a munlaji, manh xchiok lu'um.
Hanhejtona', tom smoj syal heb' uninab'il t'a smam snun icha tik: ¿Tas yuj icha tik kajkan eyu'uj? tom xchi heb'.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, Haxonhej Ochi, a b'ojinak onh, a tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tom ay eyalan heyik he k'anb'an t'ayin yuj tas tzin k'ulej heyet'ok? ¿Tom a ex ol eyal tas ol in k'ulej?
Ha in in b'onak lum lum tik yet' masanil mach kajan t'ay. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha'anh yet' in poder, walannak to scheklaj masanil k'e'en k'anal.

T'a stojolal ol wutej ayik ol wak'anoch winhaj Ciro t'a yopisio. Ha in ol in b'ob'at b'e t'a yichanh winh yik ol yak' ganar winh. Ha winh ol b'oanxik'e in chonhab' Jerusalén. Haxo heb' in chonhab' ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok nacional, ol ak'jokel heb' t'a libre yuj winh t'a nab'anhej. Malaj stojol ol sk'an winh t'a heb', malaj spak ol ak'chaj t'a winh, a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swalkan jun tik, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová t'a heb' israel icha tik: Ha tastak ay t'a heb' aj Egipto yet' t'a heb' aj Etiopía, heyik ol ajkanok. Ha heb' aj Sabá cha'anh ste'el, ol yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol he k'ab'. Ol ochkan heb' he chekab'ok. Ayoch k'e'en cadena t'a heb' ol och tzak'an heb' eyu'uj, ol em kuman heb' t'a eyichanh, ol yalan heb' icha tik: Wal yel junnhej ton wal Dios, malaj junokxo. Haton jun Dios chi' ayek' heyet'ok, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.
Yelton wal Dios ach, max ach kilochlaj, palta ko Kolumal aj a onh israel onh tik.
Masanil heb' sb'o'an yechel komon Dios, k'ixwelal ol aj heb', ol b'atkan heb'.
Ha onhxo pax israel onh tik jun, a ach ol onh a kol t'a junelnhej. Malaj b'ak'inh emnakilal, ma k'ixwelal ol onh ajkanok.

Mamin Jehová, a ach a b'onak satcha'anh, a ach a b'onakkanem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. Maj a b'olaj lum yik malaj tas ay t'a sat, palta a b'onak lu'um yik skajchaji. Ha ach tzal icha tik: Ha innhej Jehová in, malaj junokxo.

Ha in tik, manh elk'altakok tzin loloni, manhok pax t'a k'ik' k'inal t'a yoltak lum lum. Malaj tas walnak t'a heb' yinhtilal Jacob icha tik: Manh in he komon sayejek'i, manh xin chiok t'a heb'. Ha in Jehová in tik, anhej tas yel yet' tas tojol swala', xa chi.

Syalan Jehová icha tik: Masanil ex ayextoek' t'a junjun nación, molb'ejek he b'a, kotanhek. Malaj jab'ok he pensar, a te te' tzeyak'och he diosalok, tze b'akhan b'eyek'ok, tzex och ejmelal t'a jun Dios max yal skolwaji.

Lolonanhek, alek tastak tze na chi' t'ayin, al-lajek eyab' junjun ex. ¿Mach aljinakkan juntzanh tik yiktax yichb'anel? ¿Mach aljinakkan t'a peka'? ¿Tom manhok in Jehová in walnakkan juntzanh tik jun? Malaj junokxo Dios. Ha innhej toni. Ha innhej ton swak'elk'och tas swala', Kolwajwum in paxi.
Jantak ex kajan ex b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik, ojtakejek in eli, ol ex in kolo', yujto Ha innhej Dios in, malaj junokxo.
Ha in wal swak' in ti' to yel tas swala', manh ol in k'ex tas swal tik. Ol em kuman masanil anima t'a wichanh, ol in yojtakanel heb'.
Ol yalan heb' smasanil t'ayin icha tik: Ha achnhejton Jehová tojol ach, ay a poder, xcham heb'. Haxo masanil heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin, ol k'ixwokkan heb'.
Wu'ujnhej ol kolchaj masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel, ol yak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha sdiosal heb' aj Babilonia skuch Bel, k'ixwelal ix ajkani, haxo sdiosal heb' aj Nebo, manhxalaj yelk'ochi. Ha juntzanh komon Dios chi', ix tzek'jioch t'a yib'anh yikatz nok' b'uru al yaji, k'unb'inak nok'.
Ha juntzanh komon Dios chi', manhxa jab'ok yopisio, maj yal skolan sb'a, ix ik'chajb'at t'a ch'ok nacional.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Maklejek eyab' tas swal ex yinhtilal Jacob, jantak exto kannak ex t'a Israel tik, kuchb'ilexnhej wu'uj ayik manto ex alji. Ix ex in chelb'eyek'ok.
Ichanhej chi' ol in k'ulej heyet'ok, ayik ol ex och icham anima'il, sakxo xil he jolom, ayinnhej och heyet'ok. Ha in in b'onak ex, ol ex in tanhwejnhej. Ol in ochnhej heyet'ok, ol ex in kolnhej.
¿Mach junok syal in he lajb'an yet'ok? ¿Mach junok lajan wet'ok he na'ani?

Ay heb' syik'k'eta k'e'en oro t'a yol yet'tal, syechtan k'e'en plata t'a yol echlab', syak'an k'e'en heb' t'a junok winh jelan sb'o'ani yik sb'o junok sdiosal heb' t'a k'e'en. Haxo sb'oelk'ochi, tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ay, syalan sb'a heb' t'ay.

Syak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom sjenhjab', syik'anb'at heb'. Syak'ank'e heb' t'a sat junok smexa. Skanxonhej chek'an ta', maxtzak ib'xi. Wach'chom jantak yawajoch heb' ay yik chi' t'ay, palta max tak'wi, max kolji heb' yuj t'a syahelal.
Naekkot jun tik ex anima pit, scham wal he na'ankoti yik max b'at satk'olal eyu'uj tastak in k'ulejnak.
Naekkot tas ujinak t'a pekataxo to Ha innhej Dios in, malaj junokxo, malaj junokxo Dios lajan wet'ok.
Ha in walnakkan t'a yiktax yichb'anel tas ol ujok t'a slajwub'. Ayokto walannakkani tastak toto ol ujok. Masanil tas nab'il wu'uj ol in k'ulejnhej.
Ol wawtejkot jun winak t'a najat b'aj sjawi k'u, ol ja juknaj icha junok nok' ch'akb'a. Ha tas nab'il wu'uj, a chi' ol wak' sk'ulej. Icha wutejnak walani, icha chi' ol ujok.
Ex anima pit, mach ex najat eyajkanel t'a tojolal, ab'ek tas ol wala'.
Ha kolnab'il swak'a' toxo wal tz'elk'och wu'uj, manhxo ol ek' tiempo in kolan chonhab' Sion, ol b'inajxok Israel tik wu'uj, xchi Jehová.

Icha tik yalan Jehová yuj Babilonia: Emanhkot t'a a despacho ach Babilonia, emanh k'ojan t'a kal pokok. Ha t'a peka' lajan ach icha junok ix kob'es mantalaj winak syik'a'. Haxo tikne'ik manhxo ol alchajok to yune' kob'es ya ilab'il ach. Ha tikne'ik chekab' hachxo.
Ochanh t'a k'e'en cha', jax ixim trigo, ik'el smusil a sat, tok'k'e a k'apak t'a a xub' yik tzach k'axpaj t'a yol ha ha'.
Iljokab' a niwanil b'eranel chi', ilchajokab' a niwanil k'ixwelal yilji. Ha jun chi' ol wak' spakok t'ayach, malaj junok mach het'nak b'aj ol ok' in k'o'ol, xchi Jehová.
Ha ko Kolumal a onh israel onh tik, ko Diosal Haxonhej Ochi, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, a tz'alan icha tik:
Ex caldeo, emanhek k'ojan t'a kuseltakil t'a kal k'ik' k'inal. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol ex b'inaj yajalil t'a juntzanhxo niwak nación.

Ayik aykot wowal t'a in chonhab', ix waktejkan heb', ichato manh in chonhab'ok heb'. Ix wak'och heb' t'a k'ixwelal, ix wak'ankanoch heb' t'a yol he k'ab', maj ok' he k'ol t'a heb'. Ipan heb' ichamtak animaxo ya ix eyutej.
Ix eyalanpax icha tik: Ha onh tik yajal onh t'a masanil tiempo, xe chi. Malaj jab'ok tas ix he na' tas ol ex ajelk'ochok.

Yuj chi' ach chonhab' Babilonia, ab' wal tas ol wala': Lajan ach icha syutej sb'o'an sb'a junok ix ajmul ix. Te junk'olalxo ajek'i, tza na'an t'a a pensar to malaj junokxo mach lajan icha ach tik. Tza na'ani to malaj b'ak'inh ol ach kan icha junok ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum, malaj b'ak'inh pax ol ach kan manh uninal a na'ani.

Wach'chom jantak heb' ajchum yet' heb' ajb'a'al, palta manhxo ol ach koljok yuj heb' ayik ol ja lemnaj cha makan chi' t'a ib'anh, haton junixtakil yet' manh uninal. Junnhej k'uhal ol jawok lemnaj juntzanh chi' t'ayach.
Ha a na'ani to wach'nhej ajek' t'a a chukal chi', malaj mach tz'ilan tas tza k'ulej. Ha tas ojtak yet' a jelanil tzach ak'an musansatil. Tza na'ani to a achnhej, malaj junokxo.

Palta ol ja wal jun yahelal t'a ib'anh, manhxo ol yal a yamanoch wa'an yet' heb' ajb'a'al chi'. Ayik ol jawok jun yahelal chi', manhxo ol yal a kachani. Ol jawok lemnaj t'a ib'anh ayik manh na'anok u'uj.
B'eyb'alej ajchumal yet' ajb'a'alil chi', haton juntzanh chi' a k'ayb'ejnak yiktax kob'es ach. Ol wila'' tato olto och yopisio u'uj, ol wila'' tato olto xiw heb' anima t'ayach yuj.

Tzijtum heb' ak'um razón ix smolb'ej sb'a het'ok, ix ach tzaktzajk'och yet' heb'. Jawokab' heb' schuman yet' k'e'en k'anal chi' tikne'ik. Ayik syilan k'e'en k'anal chi' heb', snachajel yuj heb' yalani. Ha heb' tz'alan tas tzuji t'a junjun uj, jawokab' heb' ach skol tikne'ik.

Palta lajan ol aj heb' icha yok ixim trigo, a k'ak' ol nhusantz'a heb'. Manhxo ol yal skolan sb'a heb' t'a kal k'ak' chi'. Ha jun k'ak' chi' te ow, manh lajanok icha junok komon k'ak' skan stzak'ak'il tzonh em k'ojan tzonh k'axni t'a sti'.

Icha chi' ol ajelk'och heb' a kolwajum chi', haton heb' b'aj ix a k'anb'ejnhej yiktax ach kotochi. Ol ach aktajkan yuj heb' smasanil, junjun heb' ol b'atkan t'a sb'e'al satnakil, manhxa junok mach ol ach kolanok, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek wal jun tik ex yinhtilal Jacob, ex tze kuch Israel, yinhtilal ex pax Judá. Tze lok in b'i a in Jehová in tik, tzeyalani to tzex och ejmelal t'ayin he Diosal in, palta manh yelok tzeyala', chab'satil tzex loloni.
Tzeyalani to aj chonhab' ex t'a in chonhab' wiknhej yaji. Tzin eyak'anoch yipok he k'o'ol eyalani, a in ton Jehová he Diosal in Yajal in t'a Smasanil.
Ayokto walannakkan yuj tas ix uji tik. Ha in wal ix wak' eyojtakejeli. Elanhchamel ix laj elk'och tas walnakkan chi'.
Wojtak to te pit ex, max eyik'em he b'a, max ex k'ixwi jab'ok t'a wichanh.

Ayokto walannakkan t'ayex ayik manto uji juntzanh tik. Yuj chi' max yal eyalan icha tik yuj juntzanh he komon Dios nab'a te', ma k'e'en: Ha ko diosal tik ix na'an jun tik, a ix ak'an elk'ochi, manh xe chiok.
Ha ex tik eyab'nak masanil tas walnakkan chi'. Scham wal he na'an yuj, tzeyalaneli to yel walnak. Haxo tikne'ik ol wak' eyojtakejel juntzanhxo tas k'ub'eltak yaji, juntzanh manh eyojtakok.
Haton tas to hato tikne'ik swala', manh walnakok t'a peka', juntzanh tas to malaj b'aj eyab'nak spekal yalji masanto tikne'ik. Yuj chi' manh ol yal eyalani to eyojtakxo.
Yel toni, a jun tik manta b'aj eyab'nak, manto eyojtakok, hanheja' manto eyab'pax tikne'ik. Yujto wojtaktaxoni to max he k'anab'ajej, pit ex yiktax ex alji.
Palta ay in niwank'olal t'ayex, yuj chi' ix in yamoch wa'an yowal in k'ol t'a eyib'anh yuj in b'inajnakil. Maj ex in sateli yik manh chukok tz'aj in b'inaji.
Naek to ix ex in sakb'itej, manh ichok tz'aj k'e'en plata t'a kal k'ak', palta haton yet' yahelal ix ex wak' prowal.
Yuj wik'jicha'anh, icha chi' ex wutej, yik manh chukok tz'aj yalchaj in b'i. Ha aloj wach' lolonel smoj yalji t'ayin, max in cha alchaj t'a junokxo, xchi Jehová.
Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ex israel yinhtilal Jacob, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ha ex sik'b'il ex el wu'uj. Ha innhej ton Dios in, b'ab'el waj t'a smasanil, slajwub' in paxi.
Ha in wak'nakkanem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, in jenhb'annakb'at satcha'anh yet' in poder. Tonhej walnak sb'i juntzanh tik, spitzwinakcha'anh.

Molb'ejek he b'a he masanil, tzeyab'an tas ol wala': ¿Mach wal junok komon Dios ayokto yalannak to a jun winh winak sik'b'ilel wu'uj, a winh ol k'ulan masanil tas nab'ilxo wuj t'a yib'anh Babilonia to a yipalil ol satanel heb' caldeo?
Ha in ol wawtejkot winh, ol jawok winh, yalnhej b'aj ol b'at winh, ol yak'nhej ganar winh.

Nitzekkot he b'a t'ayin, ab'ek tas ol wala': Yiktax ix in yamanoch in lolon t'a heb' anima, k'unnhej snachajel tas swala', haxo tz'elk'och tas swal chi', ayinnhej ek' ta', xchi Jehová. Ha tikne'ik jun, chekb'il in kot yuj Jehová Yajal, yik tzin lolon yuj spoder Yespíritu.
Ha Jehová Dios, ko Kolumal a onh israel onh tik Haxonhej Ochi, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, a in tzin ch'ox t'ayex tas ol och he wach'ilok, a in tzin ch'ox b'e b'aj smoj tzex b'ati.
Komonok wal ix he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il, tato icha chi' a wach'ilal tze cha'a tzam k'enhej cha'anh icha ha' niwak ha' max tupi, haxo he kolnab'il tzam janhej icha skotnhej b'alaljok sat ha' mar.
Manhxom b'ischajb'enok heb' eyinhtilal, icha yarena'il sti' ha' mar. Maj am wik'emta he b'isul, maj am in b'at mikan t'ayex, xchi Jehová.

Syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Elanhek t'a Babilonia, elanhek elelal t'a skal heb' aj Caldea. Alekel jun ab'ix tik yet' aw yik tzalajk'olal. Tzeyak'an ojtakajel masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Tzeyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová onh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' Babilonia, a onh yinhtil onh Jacob, haton jun schekab', xe chi, xchi Jehová.
Ayik yek'nak heb' ko mam kicham t'a takinh lu'um yuj Jehová, manh takjinakok sti' heb', yujto a Jehová chi' pojjinak k'e'en tenam, yelnakkot chulnaj ha' niwak ha' sb'eyi.
Haxo pax heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj jab'ok wach'il ol scha heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha jun schekab' Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ex anima kajan t'a stitak ha' mar, ab'ek tas ol wala'. Ex anima te najat ayex, maklejek eyab'i: Ha Jehová awtannak in ayik manto in alji. Yalnakkanel in b'i ayik kuchb'il hinto och yuj in nun.

Ha tas swala' lajan icha k'e'en espada te jay ye, icha chi' ajnakkan yuj Dios. Sk'ub'ejnak in el t'a yalanh sk'ab'. Icha junok jul-lab' te jay snhi', icha chi' yutejnak in, sk'ub'ejnak in t'a yol yet'tal sjul-lab'.
Yalannak t'ayin icha tik: Ach Israel in chekab' ach, u'uj ol cheklaj in wach'il, xchi t'ayin.

Palta ix in na'ani to nab'anhej ix in munlaji. Nab'anhej ix el wip, malaj tas ix wik'a', xin chi. Palta wojtak to chekel yaji tas waj t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha spak in munlajel chi', ayek' t'a yol sk'ab'.

Haxo tikne'ik jun, toxo ix in cha sniwanil welk'och t'a yichanh Jehová in Diosal, a tz'ak'an wip. Ayinto ek' t'a yol sk'ol in nun ix sna'ani to tzin och schekab'ok, yik swik'an meltzaj heb' israel yinhtilal Jacob junelxo t'ay.

Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: In chekab' ach yik tza tojolb'itanxi heb' yinhtilal Jacob, tzik'anxi meltzaj heb' israel kannakto tik t'ayin. Palta manhoknhej yuj chi' ix ach in sik'kaneli, palta yik tzach wak'och sakilk'inalil t'a juntzanhxo nación masanto b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal, yik skolchaj heb' wu'uj, xchi t'ayin, xchi jun schekab' chi'.

Ha Jehová Skolumal Israel, Dios Haxonhej Ochi, slolon t'a schekab', haton jun patikab'ileli, yajb'il yuj masanil nación, chekab' pax yajoch t'a heb' yajal. Syalan icha tik: Ayik ol ach yilan heb' yajal, ol k'e wa'an heb', ol em nhojan heb' t'a ichanh, yujto a in Jehová sDiosal in Israel, Ha inxonhej Ochi, ix ach in sik'eli, swak'anelk'och tas walnak, xchi Jehová.

Syalan Jehová t'a schekab' icha tik: Ayik ol k'och stiempo'al in ch'oxan in wach'k'olal, ol ach in kolo', ol in pakan tas ix a k'an t'ayin. Ol ach in tanhwej, ol ach wak'och yik tzak'anelk'och in trato yet' masanil chonhab', yik sb'ochajxik'e in chonhab', yik tza pojanxiek' smakb'en heb' t'a lum lum kannak tzinan.

Tzin chekan al t'a heb' icha to preso yaj t'a k'ik' k'inal icha tik: Elanhekkan t'a libre, xa chi. Ol ilchaj tastak tz'och yuj heb', icha nok' kalnel yax b'aj stanhwaj wa t'a titak b'e, haxo t'a lum takinh sat, ayxo tas swa nok'.
Manhxo ol yak' wejel heb' yet' takinhtial, manhxo ol yab' sya'il heb' yuj sk'ak'al yok k'u, yujto a in tzin xajanej heb', ol wik'b'at heb' b'aj ay sjajtak ha ha'.
Ol in jak jun b'e t'a jolomtak witz, te wach' ol aj in b'oan sb'e'al in chonhab', xchi Jehová.
Ileknab' skot in chonhab' t'a najat, ay heb' skot t'a norte, ay pax heb' skot b'aj tz'em k'u, ay pax heb' skot t'a yol yik Sinim.

Awajokab' satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik t'a tzalajk'olal. Yet' lum niwak witz elokab' yaw lum yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto a Jehová wan yak'an sniwanil sk'ol schonhab'. Toxo ix ok' sk'ol t'a heb' ayoch t'a syahelal.
Syalan heb' aj Sion icha tik: Ix onh yaktejkan Jehová, ix onh b'atkan satk'olal yuj Kajalil, xchi heb'.
Palta syalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ha junok ix nunab'il, ¿tokwal sb'at satk'olal yune' ix yuj? Wach'chom sb'at satk'olal yuj ix jun, palta a in tik manh ol ex b'at satk'olal wu'uj.
Ichato tz'ib'ab'il he b'i t'a yol in k'ab', yuj chi' na'an exnhej wu'uj.
Elanhchamel ol b'ochajxik'e smuro'al he chonhab', haxo heb' ajk'ol pojjinakemi, heb' satannakeli, wanxo yel heb'.

Ex aj Sion, ileknab' t'a he patik eyichanh, a heb' ik'b'ilb'at t'a ch'ok nacional, wan smolb'anxi sb'a heb' yik sjax heb' heyet'ok. Ha in Jehová in tzin lok in b'i swalani to ol eyik'cha'anh he b'a yuj heb' eyetchonhab' chi'. Icha wal stzalaj junok ix kob'es yuj yelwanub' spichul ayik snupnaji, icha chi' ol aj he tzalaj yuj heb' wan sjax chi'.
Yujto a he chonhab' tik mak'b'ilkanem lanhnajok, kuseltak yajkani. Haxo tikne'ik, manhxo ol yab'laj lum skajan heb' anima chi'. Ha heb' mak'jinakkanem lanhnaj chi', najatxo ay heb'.
Ha heb' yuninal heb' aljinak t'a ch'ok nacional chi', ol yal heb' t'ayex icha tik: Te jab'nhej jun lum lum tik t'ayonh, ak'ek ko lu'um b'aj tzonh kajnaji, xcham heb'.

Ol he na'an icha tik: ¿Mach ay yuninal juntzanh heb' tik? Ha onh tik manhxalaj kuninal. Maxtzak yalpaxlaj yalji heb', ik'b'il onh b'at t'a jun ch'ok nacional, chakb'il onh eli. ¿Mach ix ilan k'ib' heb' kuninal tik? ¿B'ajtil ix kot heb'? xe chama.
Ha in Jehová Eyajal in ol wal t'a juntzanhxo nación, ol wik'anpaxcha'anh in bandera yil heb', yik ol ik'jokkot heb' eyuninal chi' yuj heb', ol ul ak'jokkan heb'.

Ha heb' yajal, icha he mam ol aj heb', haxo heb' ix yetb'eyum heb', icha he nun ol aj heb' ix. Ol em nhojan heb' yajal chi' t'a sat lu'um t'a eyichanh, emnakil ol aj heb' yik tzex yik'ancha'anh heb'. Hata' ol nachajel eyu'uj to a in Jehová in, a innhej Dios in. Ha heb' tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol, manh ol kan heb' t'a k'ixwelal, xchi Jehová.
Ha junok winh winak te ay yip, ¿tzam yal stok'jiek' masanil tas ix yik' winh t'a owal? ¿Tzam yal stok'jikanek' junok presowum t'a junok yajal te ow?

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha t'a heb' te ay yip ol in tok'kanek' heb' presowum. Ha t'a heb' yajal ek'b'al te ow, ol in tok'kanek' tastak ix yik' heb' t'a owal. Yujto a in ol wak' owal yet' heb' eyajk'ol chi', ol in kolan heb' eyetchonhab' chi'.

Ha in ol wak' sk'ulej heb' ix ex ixtan chi', to ol smil-lajcham sb'a heb'. Ol och heb' icha uk'umanhil yuj skot yowal b'aj ol smil-lajcham sb'a chi'. Yuj chi' ol yojtakejel masanil anima to a in ton wal Jehová he Kolumal in. Ha in sDiosal in winhaj Jacob to Syal Wuj Smasanil, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik t'a schonhab': Ex israel, ¿tom tze na'a to a in ix ex in pechb'at icha junok winh spechanb'at yetb'eyum? Tato icha chi', ¿b'ajtil ay yumal puklajb'ail ix in b'o chi' heyet'ok? ¿Tom a in ix ex in chonhb'at chekab'ok? Tato icha chi' ¿mach b'aj ay in b'ok, yuj chi' ix ex in chonhb'ati? Ha ex tik, ix ex ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok nacional yuj he mul, yuj he chukal.

¿Tas yuj ayik ix in jawi, malaj mach ix wila''? ¿Tas yuj ayik ix ex wawtani malaj mach ix in tak'wani? ¿Tom max techaj wuj ex in kolan he na'ani? ¿Tom max yal ex wak'anel t'a libre? Naek wal to k'okb'il junok b'elanh lolonel swala', stupem ha' mar, haxo b'aj sb'ey ha' niwak ha', takinh tz'ajkani, haxo nok' chay, xcham nok' yuj takinhtial, sk'ab'at nok' yuj manh ha'il.
Ha in swak' k'ik'b'okel satcha'anh, icha heb' skus yuj schamnak, xchi Jehová.

Ha jun schekab' Jehová chi' tz'alan icha tik: Ha Jehová Wajalil, a ix ak'an jelanb'ok in loloni yik wach' swak' stek'anil heb' k'unb'elal yaji. Junjun k'inhib'alil syak'an in nib'ej yik swab' tas syak' in k'ayb'ej.
Ha Jehová Wajalil ix ak'an sjelanil in pensar, ix in k'anab'ajejnhej, manh pitok ix wutej in b'a.
Ix wak' yich in patik smak' heb' ajk'o'ol. Malaj tas swal t'a heb' stzukanel xil in ti'. Maj in k'ub'ejel in sat t'a heb' tzin b'uchani yet' heb' stzub'an in sat.
Ha Jehová Yajal, a skolwaj wet'ok, yuj chi' maj chab'ax in k'ol yuj tas tzin yutej heb' chi'. Tek'an ix wutej in b'a wak'an techajok, yujto wojtak to manh ol el in k'ixwelal.

Ha jun tzin kolani, ayek' t'a in tz'ey. Tato ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a wib'anh, tzin b'at yet'ok t'a yichanh winh tzin ch'olb'itani. Ha junok ay chukal syal t'a in patik, kotokab' t'a in tz'ey tik, syalani.
Ha Jehová Yajal, ha' skolwaj wet'ok. ¿Mach ol yal yak'anoch junok tas t'a wib'anh? Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol lajwokel heb' icha junok pichul ijtakxo, xchi jun schekab' Jehová chi'.

Ha ex ay yelk'och Jehová t'a yol he sat, tzeyab'anpax tas syal schekab': Tato tzex b'ey t'a k'ik' k'inal, tato malaj tas tz'ak'an sakk'inal t'ayex, ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'o'ol, tzex b'eynhej yet'ok.
Ha exxo tzeyak'och sk'ak'al juntzanh te' yik syak' yok t'ayex, hanheja' t'a yok chi' tzex b'eyi. Ha Jehová ol ak'ankot jun yahelal t'a eyib'anh, toxonhej ol ex emkan jichan t'a skal eyahelal chi'.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha ex tze nib'ej he b'eyb'alej tojolal, tze nib'ej tzex jawi t'ayin, ab'ek wal tas ol wala': Ileknab' b'aj kotnak eyinhtilal, b'aj pax kotnak yinhtilal heb' he mam eyicham.
Ina winh he mam eyicham aj Abraham yet' ix he nun chichim ix Sara, malaj yuninal heb' ayik wawtannak heb', palta wak'nak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', tzijtum ix aj yinhtilal heb'.

Ol wak' in wach'k'olal t'a Sion, haton jun chonhab' mak'b'ilem lanhnajok. Ha lum takinh lu'um, ol yaxb'okkan sat lu'um, icha lum Edén ol aj lu'um. Yuj chi' ol tzalaj heb' kajan ta', ol b'itan heb', ol yak'an yuj diosal heb' t'ayin.
Ex in chonhab', maklejek eyab' tas ol wala', ab'ek ex junjun chonhab': Ol walel in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il. Icha sakil k'inal ol aj t'ayex.

Lak'anxo sja sk'uhal in ch'olb'itani, wan sjapax sk'uhal yik tzin kolwaji. Ha yet' in poder ol wak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh juntzanh chonhab'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a stitak ha' mar, ol yak'och in poder heb' yipok sk'o'ol.

K'eanhek k'elan t'a satcha'anh, tzex empax k'elan t'a sat lu'um tik. Ha satcha'anh chi', ol satem icha satem te' tab', haxo sat lum tik, ol k'ab'ok icha sk'ab'i junok pichul. Ha heb' anima kajan t'a sat lum tik, ol satel heb' icha satel nok' us. Palta a kolnab'il swak'a' ay t'a junelnhej. Ha in tojolal malaj slajwub'.
Ha ex eyojtak tojolal, ex tzeyak'och in cheknab'il t'a he k'o'ol, ab'ek: Manh ex xiw yuj sb'uchwal lolonel heb' anima t'ayex. Mokab' chab'ax he k'o'ol yuj tas syal heb' chi',
yujto ol satel heb' icha junok pichul ijtakxo, ma icha tz'aj junok lana pichul sk'uxjib'at yuj nok' ij. Palta a in tojolal yet' in kolwal aynhejek' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, kolwajanh, kotanh yet' a poder, icha a k'ulejnak t'a peka'. Ha ach chok' utejnak nok' niwan nok' t'a yol ha' mar, haton nok' Rahab.
Ha ach a jaknak ha' mar, haton ha' te jul yich, ha t'a sjulal yich ha' mar chi', icha b'e utejnak yik tzek' heb' kolb'il u'uj.
Ichaton chi' ol aj smeltzaj heb' kolb'ilxo el uj Mamin Jehová. Ol jawok heb' t'a Sion tik yet' b'it yik tzalajk'olal. Ol tzetzon sat heb' stzalaji, ol satel ok'el yet' kusk'olal.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová in swak' eyip, ¿tas yuj tzex xiw t'a heb' anima chamelb'a yaji, to lajan heb' icha anh ank'ultak k'un stakjieli?

Ha in Jehová in, a in in b'onak ex. Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha'anh, in b'oannakem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. ¿Tom ix in b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj, yuj chi' tzex xiw t'a jun tzex ixtani, jun sna'an ex sataneli? Palta manh ex xiwok, a in ol in satel yowal sk'ol jun tzex ixtan chi'.
Ha heb' syab' sya'il b'aj tz'ixtaj chi', elanhchamel ol koljok heb'. Manh ol cham heb' t'a yol preso, manh ol yak' wejel heb'.
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, a in b'i, Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. Ha in swak'k'e ponholjok sat ha' mar.

Ha in in jenhb'ejnakb'at satcha'anh, in b'oannakpaxem lum lum tik t'a yet'tal. Ha in swak' eyalel in lolonel, tzex in kolanel yet' in poder. Ha in swal t'a Sion: Ha ex tik in chonhab' ex, xin chi, xchi Jehová.

Hak'ekel he wayanh ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhek wa'an. Ix eyab' wal sya'il yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová ix yak'kot t'a eyib'anh, palta toxo ix ek'b'ati. Lajan ex aj icha junok mach satel sk'ol yuk'an anh anh, manhxalaj jab'ok anh chi' syaktejkan t'a yol yet'tal.
Ha t'a skal heb' eyuninal ix eyil k'ib'ok, malaj junok heb' ix ch'oxan b'e t'ayex, malaj junok heb' ix ex ketzanb'ati.

Haton cha makan tas ix jawi t'a eyib'anh tik: Ix mak'chajem lanhnaj he chonhab', ix champax heb' kajan t'ay yuj wejel yuj owal. ¿Machto wal ol ok' sk'ol t'ayex? ¿Machto wal ol ak'an sniwanil he k'o'ol?

Toxo ix el yip heb' eyuninal, toxo ix telwi heb' icha nok' k'ultakil chej skan t'a ch'anh ya'al. Toxonhej ix kan teljab' heb' t'a schikintak calle, yujto ix yab' wal sya'il yowal sk'ol Jehová he Diosal heb', yuj skachji heb' yuj.
Ex aj Jerusalén, wan eyab'an wal sya'il, icha uk'um anh eyek'i, palta manh ex uk'umok pax anh.

Ha Jehová Kajal ko Diosal paxi, ha' tz'alan icha tik: Ha in Jehová he Diosal in tzex in kolo', a in ton swal icha tik: Ol wik'ek' skopail yowal in k'ol chi' t'ayex, manhxa b'ak'inh ol eyab'xi sya'il yuj.

Ha t'a heb' ixtannak ex, hata' ol wak' jun skopail yowal in k'ol chi', haton t'a heb' aljinak t'ayex icha tik: Emanhek lachan t'a sat lu'um to ol onh b'eyek' t'a eyib'anh, xchi heb'. Emnak ex lachan t'a sat lum chi', ek'nak tek'ton heb' t'a eyib'anh icha lum pokok, xchi Jehová.
Ex aj Sion schonhab' Dios, ak'ekel he wayanh, k'eanhek wa'an, tek'b'ejek he b'a. Ch'oxekel swach'il eyilji, yujto manhxa b'ak'inh ol jax heb' ch'ok nacional ch'ok sdiosal yak' chukal t'ayex.
K'eanhek wa'an ex aj Jerusalén, mak'ekel pokok t'ayex, ol ex emxok k'ojan t'a he despacho eyak'an yajalil. Ex aj Sion, ex ix ex xit'ek' t'a ch'ok nacional, ik'ekel tas tzek'b'iloch t'a he jaj.
Ha Jehová Kajal tz'alan icha tik: Malaj wal jab'ok tumin ix in cha t'a he patik ayik ix ex ik'chajb'at chekab'ok. Hanhejtona', malaj pax tumin ol wak'a' yik tzex wik'anxi meltzajok.
Ha in chonhab' tik, b'atnak t'a Egipto t'a peka', ch'ok chonhab'il ajnak yek' heb' ta'. Haxo tikne'ik ix ixtaj heb' yuj heb' aj Asiria, wach'chom malaj jab'ok yuj.
Haxo tikne'ik, ¿tas smoj tzin k'ulej? T'a ichnhej ta' ix ik'jib'at in chonhab' tik t'a Babilonia. Ha heb' tz'ak'an yajalil t'a yib'anh heb', syik'cha'anh sb'a heb', max yaktej heb' in sb'uchani.
Yuj chi', ol k'och sk'uhal, ol yojtakejel in chonhab' tik to Dios in, ol nachajel yuj heb' to a in ix in lolon t'a heb', xchi Jehová.

Jantak swach'il kilan t'a tzalkixtak, ayik sjawi junok mach tz'alan wach' ab'ix. Yet'nak yab'ixal junk'olal, syalanpax yab'ixal kolnab'il, syalan icha tik: Ex aj Sion, a he Diosal wan yoch Reyal, xchi.
Ab'ek, a heb' stanhwumal he chonhab', tz'el yaw heb', jun lajan tz'aj sk'e nhilnaj heb' yel yaw yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto syil wal heb' sjax Jehová t'a Sion.
Ex aj Jerusalén juwinakkan he chonhab', elokab' eyaw he b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal, yujto ol ok'xok sk'ol Jehová t'ayex, ol skolanxi Jerusalén.
Yujto ol sch'ox spoder Jehová yil juntzanhxo nación. Masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yojtakejel heb' to ha Dios onh kolanxi.
Elanhek, elanhekta t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Babilonia. Ha ex eyet'nak yamk'ab' yik stemplo Jehová, manh eyam tas manh wach'ok, manh eyak'b'at he b'a t'a skal chukal.
Manh sk'ak'alilok, manh elelalok ol ex elta, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ol oymaj t'a he patiktak, ol ex stanhwani.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha jun in Chekab' tik wach'nhej ol elk'ochok, ol ik'jok wal cha'anh, ol b'inaj wal.
Tzijtum mach ol sat sk'ol yilani, yujto ol ixtax yilji, manhxo anima'ok ol aj yilji yuj tas ol utajok.

Icha pax chi' jantak nación, ol sat sk'ol yilani ayik ol ik'jokcha'anh. Ha heb' rey toxonhej ol och k'elan heb', yujto ol yil heb', ol nachajel yuj heb' tas to manta b'aj ix yab' heb' yalji, xchi Jehová.
Ol yal Israel icha tik: ¿Tok ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ol tas skaleli? ¿Tok ay mach snachajel yuj to a spoder Jehová scheklaj t'a jun ab'ix tik? xcham heb'.
Snib'ej Jehová to a jun schekab' chi' sk'ib' icha swol junok te te' tz'em sch'anhal yib' t'a takinh lu'um. Manh nib'ab'ilok yilji, malaj tas wach' skiloch t'ay.

Ha heb' anima, ol sb'uch jun chekab' chi' heb', ol spatikejel heb'. Ol ak'jokoch yahelal t'a yib'anh yuj heb', ol techaj yuj, yujto k'ajan yab'an sya'il. Icha junok mach manhxo smojok yiljiochi, ol patikajelok. Malaj ol elk'och jun chekab' chi' t'ayonh.
Ha ko na'ani to ha Dios tz'ak'anoch yahelal t'a yib'anh, syak'anpaxkan t'a emnakilal, palta manh ichokta'. Ha ko yahelal a onh tik ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh, ol yab' sya'il ko k'exulok.
Ol tekjokek' k'e'en t'a sniwanil yuj ko pitalil, ol yab'an wal sya'il yuj ko chukal. Yuj syahelal ol yab' chi', ol ochxi junk'olal t'a ko kal yet' Dios. Yuj yechnaj chi', ol yak'xi ko k 'inal.
Ko masanil ix onh saklemkanb'at icha nok' kalnel. Junjun onh ix ko na' tas b'eal b'aj ix ko nib'ej b'aj ix onh b'atkani, haxo Jehová ol ak'ankanoch ko mul ko masanil t'a yib'anh jun schekab' chi'.

Ol ak'jok wal och syahelal yuj heb' anima, emnakilal ol aj yuj heb', palta malaj tas ol yala'. Ol ik'jokb'at yuj heb', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at nok' kalnel b'aj smiljichamok. Malaj tas ol yala', numannhej ol ajok, icha nok' kalnel sjoxchaji.

Ol ik'chajelta t'a preso yik sch'olb'itaji, ol ak'jokoch chamel t'a yib'anh. Malaj mach ol och ilk'olal yuj schamel chi'. Ol ik'chajel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj ko mul a onh schonhab' onh tik. Ku'uj ol yab' sya'il.
Malaj wal jab'ok chukal ol sk'ulej, malaj jab'ok es ol elta t'a sti'. Wach'chom icha chi', a sna'an heb' anima to ol mukchaj t'a skal heb' chuk, palta haxo t'a skal heb' b'eyum ol mukchajok.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak' yab' sya'il in chekab' icha yaj in na'ani. Ol yak'och sb'a silab'il t'a yol sk'ab' chamel yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul masanil anima. Yuj chi' ol pitzwokkan t'a junelnhej, ol yil heb' yinhtilal. Yuj, ol elkank'och tas nab'il wu'uj.

Ayik toxo ix lajwiek' juntzanh yahelal chi' t'a yib'anh, ol tzalaj yuj spak jun yahelal chi' to manh nab'anhejok ix yab' sya'il. Tzijtum heb' anima ol ochkan wach'il yuj yojtakanel in chekab' chi' heb', yujto ol ik'jokkanel smul heb' yuj.

Yuj chi' ol wak' yopisio t'a skal heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ay yalan yik yet' heb' yak'an ganar owal, yujto ix yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Icha wal tz'utaj heb' sk'ulan chukal, icha chi' ix utaji. Ix sb'ek sb'a yuj smul masanil anima, ix tewi yuj heb' yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb' chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik t'a Jerusalén: Ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhekcha'anh he b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal. Ha t'a peka' lajan he chonhab' icha junok ix ix max unewilaj, aktab'ilkan yuj yetb'eyum. Haxo tikne'ik, lajan icha junok ix tzijtum yune' ix alji, ek'b'al sb'isul yune' ix t'a yichanh junok ix ix aynhejek' winh yetb'eyum yet'ok.
Hak'ek lewanb'ok he makb'en b'aj kajan ex, manh ex xiw he lewb'itani. Icha junok mach slewb'itan smantiado, sjuklitej sch'anhal, smak'an tzatzb'ok yestaca'il, icha chi' tze k'ulej.

Yujto ol lewanb'ok he makb'en chi', yuj chi' ol eyik'kanek' slum heb' anima kajan t'a he patik eyichanh. Ha heb' eyinhtilal ol ak'an ganar juntzanhxo nación, ol kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' kannak tzinan.

Ex aj Jerusalén, manh ex xiwok, manhxo ol ex kan t'a k'ixwelal, manhxo emnakilok ol ex utajok. Manhxo ol he nakot tas ajnak yel he k'ixwelal t'a peka', ayik ex aktajkan icha junok ix ix manhxa yetb'eyum.
Yujto a in in b'onak ex, icha eyetb'eyum waji. Ha in b'i Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil. E Kolumal waji, he Diosal a inxonhej Ochi, sDiosal in pax masanil anima.
Ha he chonhab' tik, lajan icha junok ix kob'es ix aktab'ilkan yuj yetb'eyum, kusk'olal yajkan ix. Icha chi' ajnakkan he chonhab' tik, haxo tikne'ik, Ha in he Diosal in tzex wawtejxi.
Ex aj Jerusalén, kennhej tiempo'al ix ex waktejkani, haxo tikne'ik, tzex in cha'anxi yujto te xajan ex wu'uj.
Ix kot wowal t'ayex jun pekti', ix in k'ub'ejel in b'a t'ayex, palta yujto tzex in xajanej t'a junelnhej, yuj chi' ix ok'xi in k'ol t'ayex, a in ton Jehová he Kolumal waji, a in swala'.

Icha wal wutejnak wak'an in ti' t'a winhaj Noé to manhxa b'ak'inh ol jax jun owal ha' mukjinak yol yib'anhk'inal tik, icha chi' tz'aj wak'an in ti' tikne'ik, manhxo ol kot wowal t'ayex junelxo, manhxo ol ex in tumej.

Wach'chom sk'exmaj yet'tal lum niwak witz, tz'em lanhnaj lum tzalkixtak, palta malaj b'ak'inh ol waktej ex in xajanani. Malaj b'ak'inh ol lajwok in trato ix wala' to aynhej junk'olal t'a in kal heyet'ok. Ha in Jehová in swala'.

Ix yalanxi Jehová icha tik: Ob'iltak ex, ex aj Jerusalén. Ix eyab' wal sya'il yuj tas ix ek' t'a eyib'anh, malaj wal junok mach ix ak'an sniwanil he k'o'ol. Haxo tikne'ik ol wak'kanem he chonhab' tik t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'e'en wach' yilji, ol wak'ankanem yich t'a yib'anh k'e'en zafiro.
Ha yelwanub' he chonhab', ol in b'o yet' k'e'en rubí, haxo spuerta'il, ol in b'o yet' k'e'en berilo, haxo smuro'al ol in b'o yet' k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji.
Ol in k'ayb'ej heb' eyuninal yik wach' ol aj yelk'och heb'.
Ha tojolal, ol yik'nhej yipok t'a he kal, ol ex kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima tzex ixtani, heb' tzex xib'tani. Manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok.
Tato ay mach ol jawok yak' owal heyet'ok, manhok in swak'kot heb', yuj chi' ol eyak'nhej ganar heb'.
Ileknab'i, a in ix in b'o winh tenum k'e'en, syak'och sk'ak'al te' tzak'ak' winh yik sb'o'an yamk'ab' winh yik owal. Ha in pax ix in b'o heb' satanel anima yet' juntzanh syamk'ab' winh chi'.

Palta malaj junok yamk'ab' yik owal ol yal ex sataneli. Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch tas t'a eyib'anh, numanxonhej ol ajkan heb' eyu'uj. Haton juntzanh tik swak' t'a heb' tzin ak'an serwil. Ha in ol ex in kolo', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Masanil ex stakji he ti', kotanhek, ul uk'ek ha ha'. Ha ex malaj he tumin, kotanhek ul chaek tas tze wa t'a nab'anhej, ul chaek yal uwa yet' lech manh tupb'ilok.

¿Tas yuj tze komon lajej he tumin t'a tas manh waelok? ¿Tas yuj tze komon lajej he tojol tze cha t'a tas to max b'ut'ji he k'ol yuj? Ab'ek wal sik'lab'il tas ol wala': Tato tze k'anab'ajej tas swala', ol he wa wa'el te wach', ol ex b'ut'jok wal sik'lab'il.
Kotanhek t'ayin, maklejek wal eyab' tas swala', ol ex ajnhejek'ok. Ol in b'o junok in trato heyet'ok t'a junelnhej yujto tzex in xajanej, yik tz'elk'och in ti' wak'nak t'a winhaj rey David.
Ha in wak'nakoch winhaj David chi' testigo'al t'a juntzanhxo nación, yik skuchb'an winh, ma yik syak'an yajalil winh t'ay.
Ol eyawtejkot heb' anima manh eyojtakok. Ha heb' anima chi' elanhchamel ol ja lemnaj heb' t'ayex, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, Ha inxonhej Ochi, a in ol ex wak' ik'jokcha'anh, xchi Jehová.
Hak'ekoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yakb'an tzato yal eyawaj t'ay. Awajanhek t'ay, yakb'an lak'anto ayek'i.
Ha ex chuk he b'eyb'al yet' ex chuk he pensar, aktejekkan juntzanh he chukal chi'. Meltzajanhek t'a Jehová. Ol ok'xok sk'ol t'ayex, ol ex yak' niwank'olal ko Diosal.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha tas nab'il wu'uj, manh lajanok yet' tas tze na'a. Ha tas tzin k'ulej, manh lajanok yet' tas tze k'ulej.
Ha in pensar yet' tas tzin k'ulej chi' manh lajanok icha eyiko', yujto yel wal te ek'b'alxo tas tzin na' chi' t'a yichanh scha'anhil yajk'e satcha'anh t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.

Ha yaxnhab' yet' k'e'en sakb'akom tz'emta t'a satcha'anh, max meltzajlaj t'a ichnhej ta', palta to sch'ayxikan lum lum yuj yik wach' sk'eul masanil tas tz'awchaj t'a lu'um. Syak'an sat, tz'elta yinhatil yik syal yawchajxi, syak'anpax swa'el heb' anima.
Icha yaxnhab' chi', icha chi' yaj in lolonel, max meltzajlaj t'ayin t'a ichnhej ta', palta to sb'okan tas nab'il wu'uj, tz'elpaxk'och tas tzin nib'ej.

Tzalajk'olal ol aj eyelta b'aj ayex ek' preso'al, junk'olal ol aj he meltzaj t'a he chonhab'. Masanil lum witz, lum tzalkixtak, ichato ol k'e wal sjaj lum t'a cha'anh yuj tzalajk'olal. Ha te' niwak te', icha wal to ol stz'it sk'ab' te' stzalaji.

Ha lum b'aj ay te' k'i'ix, a te' k'ub'taj ol k'ib'ok. Ha lum b'aj ay te' sak k'i'ix, a te' arrayán ol k'ib' sk'exulok te'. Ol in k'ulej juntzanh tik yik sb'inaj in b'i a in Jehová in tik, yik tzin nachajnhejkot t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: B'eyb'alejek tojolal, aokab' tas wach' tze k'ulej, yujto toxo wal ol ex in koleli. Ol in ch'oxel in poder in kolwaji.

Te wach' yik heb' sk'anab'ajan juntzanh cheknab'il tik, sb'eyb'alan heb' icha wal yaji, haton heb' niwan yelk'och sk'uhal ik'oj ip t'ay, max yixtejb'at heb', haton heb' syailan sb'a, max sk'ulej chukal heb', xchi Jehová.

Tato ay heb' ch'ok nacional syak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, mokab' yal heb' icha tik: Ha Jehová max in cha'anoch t'a skal schonhab' tik. Hanhejtona' heb' winh malaj yuninal, mokab' yal heb' winh icha tik: Ha in tik lajan in icha junok te' takinh te'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Tato a heb' winh malaj yuninal chi' niwan yelk'och sk'uhal ik'oj ip t'ay, sk'anab'ajan pax heb' winh tas tzin nib'ej, tojol syutej sb'a heb' winh t'a in trato,

ay jun tas te wach' ol wak' t'a heb' winh t'a yichanh to ay yuninal, ma yisil. Ha jun chi', to ol b'inajnhej heb' winh t'a in templo yet' t'a skal in chonhab'. Ol wak'anpax jun sb'i heb' winh t'a junelnhej, malaj b'ak'inh ol satelok.

Haxo pax heb' ch'ok chonhab'il syak'och sb'a t'a yol in k'ab', yik tzin yak'an serwil heb', tz'ochpax heb' ejmelal t'ayin, tzin sxajanej heb', sk'anab'ajan pax sk'uhal ik'oj ip heb', tojol syutej sb'a heb' t'a in trato, ol in chaoch heb' t'a skal in chonhab'.

Ol wik'kot heb' t'a jun in tzalan wiknhej yaji. Ol wak'an tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' t'a spatil b'aj tz'och lesal t'ayin. Ol in cha silab' heb' snhustz'a t'a yib'anh waltar, yujto a in templo tik, ol alchaj yuj to spatil lesal yaj t'a masanil chonhab'.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, a in tzin molb'ejkot heb' israel aykanb'at t'a juntzanh ch'ok nacional, a in swala': Ol wik'kot juntzanh heb' ch'ok nacional yik junnhej tz'aj heb' yet' heb' israel molb'ilxo wu'uj, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex ch'ok nacional, kotanhek icha nok' chium nok'. Kotanhek milwal, ul satekel in chonhab' tik, icha syak' nok' kaltakte'al nok' sjawi, schianb'at nok' kalnel.

Yujto a heb' stanhwumal in chonhab' tik, ichato maxtzak yal yilan heb', maxtzak nachajel yuj heb' tas sk'ulej. Lajan heb' icha nok' tz'i' max chiwaji. Jichanek' heb' tzek' k'u. Anhej wayanh snib'ej heb' sk'ulej.
Lajan heb' icha nok' tz'i' tz'ochnhej swejel, malaj b'ak'inh sb'ut'ji. Ha heb' yilumal in chonhab' tik, max nachajel jab'ok yuj heb', anhej tas snib'ej heb' sayek'i.

Syalan heb' icha tik: Koyek b'at ko sayek anh anh, a anh te ow skuk'ejek, yik sk'e wal anh t'a ko jolom. Skuk'anpax anh k'ik'an icha sko k'ulej tikne'ik, mato ol te ek' yib'anh kuk'an anh jun, xchi heb'.
Ayik scham heb' anima wach' spensar, malaj mach sna'an heb'. Ayik satem heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi', malaj mach snachajel yuj to ayik scham heb' chi', skolchajkanel heb' t'a skal yahelal.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi', junk'olal yaj heb', wan yik'an yip heb' b'aj sk'och chi'.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Kotanhek t'ayin a ex tze b'eyb'alej chukal, a ex ton tze b'eyb'alej ajchumal, ex tzex em ajmulal.
¿Mach heb' tze b'uchu'? ¿Mach heb' tzeyet'tej sat, tz'elta jab'an eyak' tze chakaneli? Ha ex tik te chuk ex, te esalwum ex.
Ha t'a yichtak te' ji yet' te te' k'ayum xi'il, hata' tze k'ulej ajmulal. Tzeyak'anpax heb' eyuninal silab'il t'a he diosal t'a skaltak k'e'en k'e'en t'a stitak ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi.

Ex israel, scha wal he k'ol eyoch ejmelal t'a k'e'en k'e'en nheleli sat t'a yoltak ha' kotak ha' sb'eyi, a juntzanh chi' ix he sik'kanel he diosalok. Haton t'a juntzanh chi' tze sekem wino, tzeyak'an sat eyawb'en silab'il t'ay. ¿Am he na'ani to manh ol wak'och eyahelal yuj juntzanh tas tze k'ulej chi'?
Ha t'a lum jolomtak witz te cha'anh ay ste'al, hata' tze b'o he waynub', tze nhusanpax he silab'.

Ha t'a yoloch he puerta, hata' tzeyak'och yechel he diosal yajb'entak yilji. Ha inxo tik, tzin b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj. Tze kichanel b'eran he b'a, tzex ek' jichan t'a sat he ch'at lewan sat. Tzeyak'an he trato he mulan yet' heb' tze nib'ejochi, tzex way yet' heb'.

Tzeyik'anb'at aceite yet' jantak perfume, tzex b'at lemnaj t'a jun yechel komon Dios skuch Moloc, tzex och ejmelal t'ay. Tze chekanb'at heb' he chekab' t'a najat b'at sayanek' juntzanhxo he diosal, masanto tz'emk'och heb' b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Tzex k'unb'i eyek' t'a najat chi', palta max nachajel jab'ok eyu'uj to malaj yelk'och jun tze k'ulej chi'. Yujto te nib'ab'il jun tze sayek' chi', yuj chi' tz'ochxi eyip, tze sayanxi.
¿Mach juntzanh heb' b'aj tzex xiwi to niwan yelk'och chi' t'ayex, yuj chi' tzin eyaktejkani, tzin b'at satk'olal eyu'uj? ¿Tom yujto manhxa tas swala', yuj chi' manhxa welk'och t'ayex?
Ha tikne'ik, ol wak' cheklaj juntzanh he b'eyb'al te wach' he na'an chi', palta manh ol ex kolchajlaj yuj.

Ayik ol el eyaw he k'anan in kolwal, ol walan t'ayex: Aokab' he komon diosal chi' tzex kolani, xin chama. Ha masanil juntzanh chi', ol ik'chajb'at yuj ik', anhej yet' jun pusok ik' chi' ol b'atok. Haxo pax heb' tzin ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol jun, ol kajnajnhej heb' t'a in chonhab' tik, ol ajnhej heb' t'a lum tzalan wiknhej yaji, xchi Jehová.
Ol ab'jok yalchaj icha tik: B'o'ek jun b'e, te panhan tzeyutej, ik'ekel tastak ayem t'a yol b'e chi' yik wach' tzek' in chonhab', xchama.

Yujto ha Dios Haxonhej niwan Yelk'ochi, Aynhej ek' t'a junelnhej, skuchan pax Haxonhej Ochi, a tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tik, kajan in t'a lugar te cha'anh to wiknhej yaji, palta ay in pax ek' yet' heb' emnakilal yaji yet' heb' sna sb'a sk'o'ol yuj schukal, a in swiptzitej heb'.
Manhxo ol kot wowal t'a in chonhab' tik, manhxo ol wak'nhejkot wowal t'a heb' t'a junelnhej, talaj a juntzanh anima b'ob'il wuj tik, schab'axk'e sk'ol heb' t'ayin.

Yuj smul heb' israel tik yik sayannhej skomon diosal heb', ix kot wowal t'a heb', ix wak'anoch syahelal heb', ix in patikanel heb'. Palta ix spitejnhej wal sb'a heb', ix sk'ulan heb' icha tas snib'ej.
Ix wil wal sb'eyb'al heb', palta ol wanhtej heb', ol wak'an yik' yip heb'. Ol in tanhwan heb', ol wak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' skus yuj smul.
Ol walan t'a heb' icha tik: Ha ex najat kajan ex yet' ex lak'an ayex, junk'olalokab' eyaji, xin chama. Yujto a in ol wanhtej in chonhab' tik.
Palta haxo heb' chuk sb'eyb'al jun, lajan heb' icha ha' mar skot b'alb'on sat, max ochlaj wa'an, syik'ankot jantak k'alem.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, malaj jab'ok wach'il ol scha heb', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Awajanh t'a cha'anh, manh ach xiw awaji. Te cha'anh tz'el aw icha spuji junok k'e'en trompeta. Al t'a heb' yinhtilal Jacob tik to te pit heb', te chuk heb'.

Junjun k'u skomon och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Skomon tzalaj heb', snib'an heb' yojtakejel in b'eyb'al, icha junok chonhab'il anima sb'eyb'alan tojolal, ichato malaj b'aj syik'el spensar heb' t'a in cheknab'il, ichato sk'an juntzanh cheknab'il heb' yik tojolal t'ayin, sch'oxan heb' to stzalaj heb' sjawi t'ayin.

Ijan skot yowal heb' t'ayin syalan heb' icha tik: Nab'anhej tzonh komon och tzek'ojk'olal t'ayach, tokwal tzonh ila'. Nab'anhej skixtej ko b'a koch ejmelal t'ayach, tokwal tzonh a na'a, xchi heb'. Swalan icha tik: Yel toni, ayik tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal chi', anhej tas tze nib'ej, a chi' tze k'ulej, tzeyixtan heb' he munlajwum.
Ayik tzex komon och t'a tzek'ojk'olal chi', anhej telajb'ail yet' owal tzeyak'a', tze mak'lan he b'a yuj he chuk pensaril. Tokwal ol wab' he lesal t'a jun he tzek'ojk'olal tzeyak' chi'.

¿Tom a he na'ani to tzin tzalaj yet' tas tzeyutej he b'a chi'? Ha jun tze k'ulej chi' kusk'olal, tzex komon em nhojan icha spakchaj te' aj, tzex komon ek' jichan t'a yib'anh k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh yet' pichul ya swa'i. ¿Tom a jun chi' tzeyak' skuch tzek'ojk'olal te wach' t'a yol in sat he na'ani?

Palta manh ichok ta'. Ol wal t'ayex to a tzek'ojk'olal scha in k'o'ol, haton stzolal tik: Kolekelta heb' anima ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk spensar. Manhxo eyixtej heb' smunlaj t'ayex, aktejekel heb' tz'ixtaj chi', manhxo eyixtej heb'.

Ha heb' anima scham yuj wejel, ak'ek swa'el heb'. Haxo heb' malaj spat, ak'ek sposado heb' t'a he pat. Ha heb' malaj spichul, ak'ekoch spichul heb', manh eyaktej eyak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' eyetchonhab'.

Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, yalnhej b'aj ol cheklaj in wach'k'olal t'ayex, icha tz'aj sk'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u. Elanhchamel ol ex kolchajok. Ha in he tojolal waji, b'ab'el in b'at eyu'uj, haxo in tzikikial, tzak'an eyu'uj.

Yuj chi' tato ol ex awaj t'ayin, elanhchamel ol in tak'wok t'ayex. Tato ol el eyaw he k'anan in kolwal, ol walan t'ayex icha tik: Ina in tik, xin chama. Tzeyik'el juntzanh chukal chi' t'a he kal. Manh he suy slumal heb' eyetanima'il, manhxo he nak'e esal lolonel t'a spatik heb'.

Tato tzeyak' swa'el heb' ay swejel, tzex kolwaj t'a heb' ay tas tz'och yuj, tato icha chi', ol cheklaj he wach'il t'a skal anima icha sakil k'inal t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Ol ex cheklajel icha yok k'u t'a chimk'uhalil t'a skal k'ik' k'inal chi'.

Tato icha chi', ol ex in kuchb'ejnhej. Jantak he wa'el ol wak' t'a lum tzinan lu'um. Ol wak'an yip he niwanil, lajan ol ex aj icha junok tas awab'il aynhejoch yalil, ma icha junok sjaj ha ha' malaj b'ak'inh stupi.
Ol he b'oxik'e he chonhab' t'a yet'tal b'aj jub'ilemi, haton t'a yib'anh yich aykanem t'a peka'. Ol alchaj t'ayex to b'oumexxik'e muro lanhchajnak, b'oumexxik'e pat lanhchajnakemi.

Ha in Jehová in tik swala': Tato manh komonok tzeyutejb'at sk'uhal ik'oj ip, malaj he munlajel tze b'o t'a jun k'u wik yaj chi', tato tzex tzalaj paxi yujnhej to ay yelk'och jun k'u chi' t'ayex, max eyal komon lolonel,

tato icha chi', ol ex tzalaj wet'ok. Ha in ol wak' sniwanil eyelk'och t'a masanil chonhab'. Ol eyak' tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol t'a lum lum wak'nak he makb'enok t'a he mam eyicham aj Jacob. Ha in ton Jehová in swalkan jun tik.
Tokwal tz'el yip spoder Jehová, yuj chi' maxtzak yal skolwaji, tokwal ix chakanhb'i Jehová, yuj chi' maxtzak yab' he tewi, ma'ay.
Ha chukal tze k'ulej, a chi' ayek' t'a skal he nanhal yet' Dios. Ha juntzanh he mul chi', a tzek' makan t'a he kal yet' Dios chi', yuj chi' maxtzak yab' tas tzeyala'.
Ha ex tik, chik'tak he k'ab' he milancham anima, miktak he k'ab' he k'ulan chukal. Haxonhej es yet' chukal tz'elta t'a yol he ti'.

Malaj junok ex wach' tzeyutej he b'a. Max he ch'olb'itej yaj heb' anima t'a stojolal, ma t'a stzolal. Ha tas malaj yelk'ochi yet' esal lolonel, a tzeyak'lab'ej ayik sb'o yaj eyowal. Tze k'ulan chukal, yujto a chi' ayek' t'a he pensar.

Ha tas nab'il eyu'uj chi', lajan wal icha snholob' nok' chan. Ha mach sloan snholob' nok' chan chi', schamnhej. Ayik smak'ji pojok, a nok' kotak ajawchan tz'elta t'a yo'ol. Hanheja' tas nab'il eyuj chi', icha sch'al nok' xim yaji.
Ha sch'al nok' xim chi', max yal-laj sb'o pichul yet'ok, malaj mach spich sb'a yet' tas sb'o nok' chi'. Icha sch'al nok' xim chi', icha chi' juntzanh chukal tze k'ulej, malaj jab'ok tas tzeyik' t'ay.
Tzex b'at lemnaj t'a skal chukal. Elanhchamel tze milcham heb' anima malaj smul. Anhej t'a chukal ayoch he pensar, a b'aj tzex ek'i, jantak tastak tze satkaneli.
Anhej owal tzeyak'a', malaj jab'ok tojolal scheklaj t'a tas tze k'ulej. Ha he b'eyb'al chi', junelnhej manh wach'ok. Ha heb' tz'och tzak'an eyu'uj, malaj jab'ok junk'olal tz'ilchaj yuj heb' t'ayex.

Yuj chi' syalan heb' anima icha tik: Malaj mach stek'b'an sb'a ku'uj, malaj mach tzonh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzonh ixtani. Sko tanhwej tzalajk'olal, palta haxo kusk'olal hoyan och t'a ko patik. Sko tanhwej b'ak'inh tzonh kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzonh ixtani, palta malaj mach tzonh kolani.

Toxonhej sko machlej b'aj tzonh ek'i, icha yek' machmon junok mach max uji yilan t'a sat pat. Ha t'a chimk'uhalil tzonh telwi, ichato t'ak'walil ayonhek'i. Wach'chom tek'an onh skab'i, palta ichato chamnak onhxo.

Ay b'aj skot kowal, snhi'i'i yol ko jaj icha nok' oso, mato tzonh k'akwi icha nok' paramuch. Sko tanhwej ko ch'olb'itaj t'a stojolal, palta malaj b'ak'inh sb'o kaji. Sko tanhwej ko kolji, palta najat yajkanel t'ayonh.
Mamin Jehová, yel ix ko pitej ko b'a t'ayach. Ha ko mul chi' tz'ik'ankot t'a kib'anh. Chekel yaj ko pitalil, kojtak ko mul chi'.

Ach ko Diosal, te pit skutej ko b'a t'ayach, max ach ko k'anab'ajejlaj. Max ko nib'ejoch tzak'an ko b'a u'uj. Anhej wal chukal yet' ixtoj anima sko k'an ko k'ulej. Nab'il ku'uj tas tz'aj kak'an es yet' kixtan heb' ketanima'il.
Sko chakel b'aj sb'o yaj heb' ketanima'il. Ha tojolal, najat yajkanb'at ku'uj. Ha tas yel, manhxalaj mach scha'an yab' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' anima. Haxo tojolal chi', maxtzak cheklaj b'aj ay.

Manhxa mach tz'alan tas yel, haxo heb' snib'ej yaktankan chukal, tz'ik'jiek' tastak ay t'a heb', xchi heb' anima. Ha Jehová max scha sk'ol juntzanh tik, yujto maxtzak ch'olb'itaj heb' anima t'a stojolal.
Toxonhej sat sk'ol Jehová ayik syilani to malaj mach syak'lej sb'o'an yaj jun tik. Yuj chi' syak'och sb'a skolan heb' yet' spoder, ol yak' ganar skolan heb'.

Icha heb' soldado ayoch spichul yik owal, icha chi' ol aj sjawi Jehová yet' yowal sk'o'ol, yik syak'an spak t'a heb' ixtum anima. Ha stojolal, icha k'e'en maklab' nhi' k'ol yaji. Haxo skolnab'il, lajan icha k'e'en xumpil.

Ol spakan t'a junjun mach, hato syala' tas sk'ulej. Ol yak'anoch syahelal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ay, haton heb' kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol yak' spak t'a heb' t'a smojal.

Masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'aj sk'eul k'u, masanto b'aj tz'em k'u, ayik ol yilanoch stzikikial Jehová heb', ol xiw heb', yujto ol ja icha wal junok ha' eluma', ichato pechb'il yuj junok owal ik'.
Ha Jehová tz'alani to ol jawok skol heb' aj Sion, haton heb' yinhtilal Jacob sna sb'a yuj schukal.

Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ha tikne'ik tzin b'okan jun in trato heyet'ok, swak'ankan in ti' to a Wespíritu yet' in k'ayb'ub'al swak'kan t'ayex, ol kannhej heyet'ok. Ol eyalankan t'a heb' eyuninal yet' t'a heb' eyinhtilal ol elnhej, yik tze k'anab'ajej t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ex aj Jerusalén, k'eanhekxi wa'an, te wach' eyiko' yujto scheklajxik'e in tzikikial t'a he kal.

Haxo yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a k'ik'k 'inal ol musankanok, ichato ol kan juntzanhxo nación t'a skal jun niwan k'ik' k'inal. Ha exxo tik, a in Jehová in tik ol wak' sakil k'inal t'ayex, ol cheklajel in tzikikial t'a he kal.
Ha juntzanh niwak nación chi', ol jawok t'ayex yuj he sakil k'inal chi'. Ha heb' winh rey, ol jawok heb' winh ul yil in tzikikial ol cheklaj chi'.

K'eanhek k'elan, tzeyilan t'a he patik eyichanh to a masanil heb' eyetchonhab', ol laj smolb'ej sb'a heb' sjax t'ayex. Ha heb' eyal eyuninal, najat ol kot heb', mek'b'il heb' ol ul ak'jokkan heb' t'ayex.
Ayik ol eyilan icha chi', ol ex k'e juknaj he tzalaji, ol ex te tzalaj wal. Yujto ol laj yik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanh nación ay t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, ol ul yak'ankan heb' t'ayex.

Ol majel sat he lum tik yuj jantak nok' camello ol yik'kot heb' aj Madián yet' heb' aj Efa. Ol jawokpax masanil heb' aj Sabá, yet'nak k'e'en oro heb' yet' incienso. Ol yalanel wach' lolonel heb' t'ayin Jehová in tik, yuj tas tzin k'ulej.

Masanil nok' kalnel ay t'a Cedar, ol eyikej nok'. Masanil nok' ch'ak kalnel ay t'a Nebaiot, a nok' ol eyak'lab'ej, yik ol eyak'an nok' silab'il t'a waltar, haton silab' nib'ab'il wu'uj. Icha chi' ol wutej, yik ay yelk'och in templo t'ayex.
Ol eyalan icha tik: ¿Tas juntzanh skot chi', icha skot asun, ma icha sk'och nok' paramuch t'a yet'tal?

Ha jun ol eyil chi', haton te' barco skot t'a sk'axepal ha' mar, b'ab'el skot te' yik Tarsis yuj te'. Wan yik'jikot heb' eyuninal aykanb'at t'a najat yuj heb', yet'nak k'e'en oro heb' yet' k'e'en plata. Ol in ik'jokcha'anh a in Jehová he Diosal, Ha inxonhej Ochi. Ha in pax ol ex wak' b'inajok.

Ha heb' ch'ok nacional, a heb' ol b'oanxik'e smuro'al he chonhab', haxo heb' sreyal heb' ol ex ak'an serwil. Wach'chom yuj yowal in k'o'ol ix wak'och eyahelal, haxo tikne'ik, yuj in wach'k'olal tz'ok'xi in k'ol t'ayex.
Ha spuerta'il he chonhab', jakannhej t'a k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil yik syik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanh nación chi' t'ayex, yik sjawipax sreyal heb' t'a eyichanh.
Ha juntzanh niwak nación, ma heb' rey manh ol ex ak'an serwil, ol satjokel heb'. Manhxa b'aj ol cheklaj jab'ok heb'.
Ha jantak sb'eyumal lum Líbano ol ik'chajkot t'ayex: Haton te' taj, te' k'ub'taj yet' te' tzikap. Ol och te' swach'il yelwanub'ok in templo, yik ol wik'cha'anh jun lugar chi' b'aj ol in ajok.

Masanil yinhtilal heb' ix ex ixtan chi', ol jawok heb' yak'em sb'a t'ayex. Masanil heb' ix ex chakaneli, ol ul em kuman heb' t'ayex, ol yalan heb' t'ayex icha tik: Ha ex aj chonhab' Sion ex tik, yiknhej Jehová eyaji, haton sDiosal Israel Haxonhej Ochi, xcham heb'.
Wach'chom aktab'il ex kan t'a peka', chakb'il ex eli, manhxa mach tzek' b'aj ek'nak ex chi', palta haxo tikne'ik, ol wak' eyik'jicha'anh yet' he b'inajnakilal yuj masanil chonhab' t'a junelnhej.

Ha juntzanh nación chi', ol yak' he wa'el heb' te wach', haxo heb' sreyal heb', ol yik'kot sb'eyumal heb', ol ex yak'an serwil heb', icha syutej junok ix nunab'il yak'an chunok yune'. Icha chi' ol aj eyojtakaneli to a in Jehová he Diosal in, he Kolumal waji, a in sDiosal in winhaj Jacob, tzex in kolo'.

Ol in k'ex masanil tas ay t'ayex: Ha k'e'en oro ol wak' sk'exulok k'e'en bronce, haxo k'e'en plata ol wak' sk'exulok k'e'en hierro. Ha k'e'en bronce ol wak' sk'exulok te te', haxo k'e'en hierro chi' ol wak' sk'exulok k'e'en komon k'e'en. Ha heb' eyajalil, t'a stojolal ol ex sch'olb'itej heb', yuj chi' junk'olal ol ex ajok.

Ha t'a he lu'um chi', manhxa milojcham anima, owal yet' jantak chukal ol ujok. Manhxa tas ol satel t'a yol he makb'en chi' yuj owal. Ha in ol ex in kol icha junok muro, ol in eyik'cha'anh yujto ix ex in kolo'.
Manhxalaj ol och yok k'u eyu'uj, ma yok k'e'en uj t'ak'walil, yujto a in Jehová sakil k'inal ol in aj t'ayex t'a junelnhej. Ha in he Diosal in tik ol ex wak' b'inajok.

Ha jun sakil k'inal ol wak' t'ayex chi', a ol ochkan sk'exulok yok k'u yet' yok k'e'en uj. Ha jun chi', malaj b'ak'inh ol tupok, yujto a in Jehová in sakil k'inal ol in aj t'ayex t'a junelnhej. Manhxa b'ak'inh ol ex kusok.
Masanil heb' eyetchonhab', wach'nhej ol aj spensar heb'. Ol yikejpax slum heb' t'a junelnhej. Lajan ol aj heb' icha swol junok te' awb'en te' awab'il wu'uj. Ol in k'ulej jun chi' yuj wik'jicha'anh.

Ha heb' kennhej sb'isul t'a he kal, ol k'ib' wal sb'isul heb', te tek'an ol aj heb' icha junok niwan chonhab'. Ayik ol k'och stiempo'al yelk'och juntzanh tik, a in wal Jehová in ol wak'elk'och t'a elanhchamel, xchi Jehová chi'.

Ha Yespíritu Jehová Kajalil ayoch t'ayin, yujto sik'b'il in el yuj. Chekb'il in kot yuj, yik tzul walel wach' ab'ix t'a heb' meb'a', swak'an stek'anil heb' manhxa yip yuj kusk'olal, swalan t'a heb' icha preso yaji to syal yel heb' t'a libre.
Swalanpaxeli to ix ja sk'uhal ko kolchaj yuj Jehová ko Diosal, sk'uhal pax yak'anek' ko pak t'a heb' kajk'o'ol. Ix in chekjikoti yik swak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' kusk'olal yaji.

Tzin jawipax wak' tzalajk'olal t'a heb' aj Sion kusk'olal yaji, haton heb' syak'k'e k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh t'a sjolom, a tzalajk'olal swak' sk'exulok ok'el. Ha b'it yik aloj wach' lolonel swak'kanoch sk'exulok ilk'olal. Lajan ol aj heb' icha junok te' ji awab'il yuj Jehová, yik sb'eyb'alej tojolal heb' yuj yik'ancha'anh Jehová chi' heb'.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' satnakeli, ol sb'oxik'e heb', ol sb'oanpaxk'e juntzanh pat heb' mak'b'ilem lanhnaj t'a peka'.
Ex wetchonhab', a heb' ch'ok nacional ol tanhwan nok' he kalnel, he munlajel yet' eyawb'en uwa.
Ol yalan heb' to sacerdote ex Jehová, schekab' ex ko Diosal. Ol ex tzalaj yet' sb'eyumal juntzanhxo nación chi'. Wach' ol aj eyilji yuj tastak wach' yilji ol yak' heb' t'ayex.
Ha ex tik, icha wal ix aj eyab'an sya'il, k'ixwelal yet' b'uchwal, icha pax chi' ol aj he cha'an he b'eyumal yet' he tzalajk'olal, malaj slajwub'.

Yujto a wal tojolal snib'ej Jehová, skot yowal yuj elk'al yet' ixtoj anima. Yuj chi' wal t'a smojal ol aj spakan t'a heb' ix ex ixtani. Ol lajwok chi', ol sb'o'an jun strato heyet'ok t'a masanil tiempo.
Ol b'inaj wal eyinhtilal t'a skal masanil chonhab'. Masanil mach ol ex ilanok, ol nachajel yuj heb' to a Jehová tz'ak'an swach'k'olal t'ayex.

Tzin te tzalaj wal tikne'ik yuj Jehová, tzin k'e wal cha'anh in tzalaj yuj in Diosal, yujto te wach' ix yutej yak'an in kolnab'il yet' tojolal, ichato ix och in pichulok yuj. Icha swach'il tz'ajoch spichul junok winh kelem yet' junok ix kob'es ayik snupnaj heb', icha chi' in yutej.
Icha tz'aj sk'eul tas sk'ib' t'a sat lu'um, ma icha yelta swol junok te te', icha chi' ol aj yak'an cheklaj tojolal Jehová Kajal t'a yichanh masanil nación yuj yik'jicha'anh.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Yuj wal to tzex in xajanej ex aj Sion, yuj chi' manh ol in em numan. Yuj wal to tzex in xajanej ex aj Jerusalén, yuj chi' manh ol wik'laj wip masanto ol cheklajel he tojolal icha yik sk'inhib'i, haxo he kolnab'il, ol cheklajel icha yajoch sk'ak'al te' taj t'a k'ik' k'inal.
Masanil nación ol och k'elan yilan he tojolal. Masanil heb' rey, ol och k'elan heb' yilan sniwanil eyelk'ochi. Yuj chi' ol ak'chajoch junxo eyak' b'i. Ha in Jehová in tik ol wak'ochi.
Icha scheklajel sniwanil yelk'och junok winh rey yuj scorona, icha chi' ol aj wak'an cheklaj sniwanil welk'ochi, yujto ayex ek' t'a yol in k'ab'.

Manhxo ol he kuch “Aktab'ilkani”, manhxo ol alchajpax t'a he lum tik, “Satb'ileli”, palta to ol he kuch: “Nib'ab'il”. Haxo lum he lu'um ol skuchkan: “Nupnajnak,” yujto nib'ab'il ex wu'uj. Yajal waj t'a lum he lu'um tik.

Yujto icha wal junok winh kelem snupnaj yet' junok ix kob'es, icha chi' ol in aj heyet'ok, ol in ochxok heyet'ok, ol in tzalaj heyet'ok, icha stzalaj junok winh kelem yet' yetb'eyum, icha chi' ol in tzalaj heyet'ok.
Ex aj Jerusalén, ix wak'kanoch he tanhwumal t'a yib'anh smuro'al he chonhab'. T'a k'uhal t'ak'wal ol yal heb' icha tik: Ha ex tzex awaj t'a Jehová, manh ex och wa'an eyawaj t'ay.
Manh he cha yik' yip Jehová, masanto ol sb'oxik'e Jerusalén tik, yik wach' masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay, xcham heb', xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová toxo ix yak' sti', ol yak'elk'och tas ix yal chi' yuj spoder. Ix yalan icha tik: Manhxa b'ak'inh ol in cha swab'at he trigo heb' ajk'o'ol, manhok heb' ch'ok nacional ol uk'anb'at he wino, haton tastak tzeyik' t'a he munlajel.
Palta to a ex wal ol he mol sat eyawb'en, ol he wa'ani, ol eyalan wach' lolonel t'ayin yuj. Ol he molanpax sat eyuwa, ol eyuk'an yal eyuwa chi' t'a yol yamak'il in templo, xchi Jehová.

Ex aj Jerusalén, elanhek t'a spuerta'il he chonhab', b'oekb'at sb'e heb' eyetchonhab' wan sjaxi. Panhan tzeyutej b'aj ch'olkixtak, tzeyik'anel k'e'en k'e'en t'a yol b'e chi'. Tzeyak'ank'e junok bandera yik sch'oxan t'a juntzanhxo nación b'ajtil ay jun b'e chi'.
Ha Jehová tz'alan t'a heb' kajan b'aj slajwik'och yol yib'anhk'inal tik: Alek t'a heb' aj Sion icha tik: Ileknab' sjawi he Kolumal, yet'nak tas ix yik' yuj smunlajel, xe chi, xchi Jehová.
Ha heb' israel, ol alchajok to schonhab' Dios yaj heb', sik'b'ilel heb', haton masanil heb' ix kolji yuj Jehová. Ha Jerusalén ol skuch Chonhab' Nib'ab'il, Manhxo Aktab'ilokkani.

--¿Mach jun skot t'a niwan chonhab' Bosra, t'a yol smakb'en Edom, chakchak spichul ayochi, te ayxo smay yilji, yet'nak wal yip skoti? Ix tak'wi Jehová icha tik: --Ha in Jehová in tzin jawi, ay in poder in kolwaji. Swalanpaxi to ol in ch'olb'itej yaj t'a stojolal, xchi.
--¿Tas yuj chakchak yilji a pichul, ichato ach tek'wiel yal sat uwa? xin chi t'ay.

Ix yalani: --Yujto ix in tek'em juntzanh nación icha stek'jiel yal sat uwa. Ha innhej, malaj junokxo nación ix och wet'ok. Aykot wowal ix in tek'anem heb' wajk'o'ol, yujto aykot yowal in k'o'ol t'a heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yoch chititok schik'il heb' t'ayin, ix chik'ax in pichul tik.
Yujto ix in na' to ix jawi sk'uhal in kolanel in chonhab', swak'anpax spak t'a heb' ajk'o'ol.

Ix in ek' k'elelok, tato ay mach skolwaj wet'ok. Palta ix satk'e in k'o'ol, yujto malaj mach tz'och wet'ok. Yuj chi' a wal yuj yowal in k'ol ix in tek'b'an in b'a, yuj chi' ix yal in kolan in chonhab' in ch'okoj.
Yet' wal yowal in k'o'ol, ix in tek'anem masanil nación. Ix in satanel heb' yet' wowal, ix b'ey wal schik'il heb' wuj t'a sat lu'um, xchi Jehová.

In gana swaleli jantak tzonh xajanej Jehová, tzin b'itan wal jantak tas ix sk'ulej ku'uj. Tzonh xajanej a onh yinhtilal onh Israel tik. Jantak tas ix sk'ulej ku'uj, ix ok'xi sk'ol t'ayonh, yujto te xajan onh yuj.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha juntzanh anima tik, in chonhab' heb', wuninal heb', manhxo ol meltzajoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin, xchi. Yuj chi' ix koljiel heb' yuj Jehová chi'

t'a masanil syahelal. Manh ch'okok mach ix schekb'at skol heb', palta a wal ix sch'ox sb'a icha ángel yik skolan heb'. Yujto xajan heb' yuj, tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb', yuj chi' ix kolji heb' yuj. Ix ketzjib'ey heb' yuj, ichataxon sk'ulej yet' heb'.
Palta te pit ix yutej sb'a heb' t'ay, ix yak'an kus Yespíritu Jehová chi' heb', haton Espíritu Haxonhej Ochi. Yuj chi' ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'a heb', ix yak'an owal yet' heb'.

Yuj chi', ix sna'ankot heb' tas ujinak t'a peka', t'a stiempo'al winhaj Moisés. Ix sk'anb'an heb' icha tik: ¿B'ajtil ay Jehová koljinak heb' ko mam kicham t'a ha' mar, stanhwumal pax heb'? ¿B'ajtil ay jun yak'nakoch Yespíritu Haxonhej Och t'a heb'?
Haton jun sch'oxnak spoder t'a winhaj Moisés. Ha Jehová pojjinak snanhal ha' mar t'a yichanh heb' schonhab', yik sb'inajnhej sb'i heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha ik'annak ek' heb' schonhab' t'a yich ha' mar chi'. Maj el nhernaj heb', icha yek' nok' chej t'a tzinan lu'um, xchi heb'.

Ha Yespíritu Jehová ik'annak b'ey heb' schonhab' chi', yik syak'an yik' yip heb', icha syak' nok' wakax tz'ik'jiem wa'el t'a lum ak'liktak. Icha chi' yutejnak yik'an b'ey heb' schonhab' chi', yik sb'inaj yuj sniwanil yelk'ochi.

Mamin Jehová, ilonhkot t'a jun et'tal to iknhej yaji, haton satcha'anh b'aj kajan ach, b'aj manh jantakok swach'il. ¿B'ak'inhto ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal yet' ipalil chi'? ¿B'ak'inh ol ok'xok a k'o'ol t'ayonh? ¿Mato ix lajwi a niwank'olal chi' t'ayonh?
Ha ach tik, ko Mam ach. Wach'chom a winhaj Abraham yet' winhaj Israel manh onh yojtakok heb', palta a ach tik ko Mam ach, toxonton ko Kolumal ach.

Mamin ¿tas yuj tzonh ik'kanel t'a yol a b'e, tzak'an pitb'okel ko pensar yik manhxa elk'och t'ayonh? Ak'xi a wach'k'olal t'ayonh a chekab' onh tik, a onh yinhtilal onh kan heb' a chonhab' to iknhej yaji.
Ha onh a chonhab' onh tik, sik'b'il onh el u'uj, jayenhej ab'il ix ko kaj lum ko lu'um, haxo tikne'ik, a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh ix tek'anem a templo.
Ichato malaj b'aj tzak' yajalil t'ayonh, ichato malaj b'aj sb'inaji to ik onh. Ichnhejta' kaji.
Mamin, komonok tza jak satcha'anh tzach emta t'a sat lu'um tik, yik tz'ib'xi lum niwak witz t'a ichanh,
icha tz'aj xejk'e ha ha' yuj te' k'ak' ow yajochi. Emanhkoti yik tzach yojtakejel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, yik tz'ib'xik'e niwak chonhab' t'a ichanh yuj xiwelal.
Komonok tza k'ulej icha a k'ulejnak t'a peka'. Ayik emnakul chi', a k'ulannak tastak manh na'anok ku'uj, te satub'tak yilji. Ha lum niwak witz ib'xinakk'e lum t'a ichanh.
Atax t'a peka' chi', malaj b'aj tz'ab'chaji, malaj b'aj tz'ilchaj junokxo Dios sk'ulan icha tas tza k'ulej yuj swach'ilok heb' tzach ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol.

T'a tzalajk'olal tza cha heb' wach'nhej tas sk'ulej, na'annhej yuj heb' sk'ulan tas tza nib'ej. Ha hachxo tzak'kot yowal a k'ol t'ayonh, yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach, sko k'ulannhej chukal. ¿Tzatom yal ko kolchaji?

Ko masanil, lajan onh t'a yol a sat icha mach manh wach'ok icha yalan ley. Masanil tas wach' sko k'ulej kalani, lajan icha junok k'apak k'apak miktak. Yuj ko chukal, yuj chi' lajan onh icha te' takinh xil te' tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik'.
Malaj junok onh sko k'an a kolwal, maxtzak ko nakot ko k'och t'ayach, yujto tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayonh, tzonh aktankan t'a yol sk'ab' ko chukal.
Palta a ach tik Mamin Jehová, ko mam ach. Ha onh tik, icha lum tz'akb'il lum kaji, a hachxo tik, ichato ko tz'akumal aji, a ach a b'onak onh ko masanil.
Mamin, mokab' te kot owal t'ayonh. Manhxo'okab' a nanhejkot ko chukal. Ina to a chonhab' onh.
Ha juntzanh chonhab' ik yaji, toxo ix kan tzinan, toxo ix lanhchajkanem Jerusalén, manhxalaj mach kajan t'ay.
Ha a templo te wach' yilji to iknhej yaji, haton b'aj ochnak heb' ko mam kicham ejmelal t'ayach, toxo ix lajwiem stz'ab'ati. Ha tas te nib'ab'il ku'uj, haton a templo chi', toxo ix lajwieli.
Mamin Jehová, ayik tzilan masanil juntzanh tik, ¿tom malaj tas ol a k'ulej yuj? ¿Tom ol ak'nhejoch ko yahelal?

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ix wak' in b'a yojtakejel heb' max in k'anb'anek'i. Ix in ch'ox in b'a t'a heb' max yal sb'a t'ayin. Ha t'a heb' max in k'anb'anek' chi', hata' ix wala': Ina in tik, xin chi t'a heb'.
Masanil tiempo jekannhejb'at in k'ab' wawtankot jun chonhab' te pit, palta haxonhej chukal snib'ej sk'ulej.
Wal t'a wichanh sk'ulej chukal heb', syak'an silab' heb' t'a juntzanh skomon diosal t'a skaltak yawb'en te' heb', snhusan incienso heb' t'a yib'anh altar b'ob'il yet' lum ladrillo.

Tz'em k'ojan heb' t'a skal b'ajtak mukan heb' chamnak. Tz'ek' ak'wal yuj heb' b'ajtak k'ub'eltak. Schi'an schib'ejal nok' chitam heb', syak'an b'ut'jok schen heb' yuj yal chib'ej to ay yowalil yuj ley.

Syalan heb' icha tik: Kananh ta', manh a nitzkot a b'a t'ayonh, yujto ch'okxo kel t'ayach, xchi heb' t'ayin. Tzin tzaktzaj wal yuj juntzanh anima tik, lajan wal tas sk'ulej heb' icha stab'il te' k'ak' ayochi tzek' k'u, sb'at t'a yol ko nhi'.
Palta masanil juntzanh schukal heb' chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a wichanh, manh tonhejok ol wilochi. Ol wak' spak t'a heb' icha wal smojal.

Yuj wal schukal heb' chi' yet' schukal heb' smam yicham heb', stzuntzejnakkot wowal heb', ayik snhusannak silab' heb' t'a jolomtak witz. Yuj chi' ol in ch'olb'itej yaj heb', ol wak'an spak t'a heb' icha wal smojal, xchi Jehová.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha junok k'ojlab' sat uwa ayto yalil, max yixtej heb' anima, yujto ayto yalil wach' yik'anel heb' t'ay. Icha chi' ol in k'ulej, manh ol in satel masanil in chonhab', yujto tzin xajanej heb' in chekab'.
Ol waktejkan jaywanhokxo heb' yinhtilal Jacob, yik wach' ayto anima ol kajnaj t'a lum lum t'a yol yik Judá. Ha heb' in chekab' sik'b'ilel wuj chi', ol kajnaj heb' ta', ol yikan lum heb'.
Ha t'a spanhanil lum Sarón, manhxo jantakok nok' kalnel ol ajok, haxo t'a yak'likal chonhab' Acor ol wa nok' wakax, haton nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' in chonhab' tz'och ejmelal t'ayin.

Palta manh ichokta' ol wak' t'ayex mach ex ix eyik'kanel he b'a t'ayin. Ha jun tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, ix b'atkan satk'olal eyu'uj, haxonhej t'a juntzanh komon Dios skuch Gad yet' Meni tzeyak' wa'el yet' wino silab'il, haton juntzanh komon Dios tz'alani tas ol ex ajok yet' tas ol jawok t'a eyib'anh eyalani.

Yuj chi' a in swala' tas ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Chuklaj tas wan ex stanhwani. Ha k'e'en espada ol ex milancham wu'uj, ol ex em kuman, ol tzepchajel he jolom. Yujto ix ex wawtej, palta maj ex tak'wok t'ayin, ix in lolon t'ayex, palta maj he cha eyab'i. Ix he k'ulej juntzanh chukal max scha in k'o'ol.
Yuj chi' a heb' in chekab' ay tas swa heb', a exxo tik ol ex cham yuj wejel. Ay tas ol yuk'ej heb', a exxo tik ol ex cham yuj takinhtial. Ol tzalaj heb', a exxo tik k'ixwelal ol ex ajkanok.
Ol b'itan heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, a exxo tik, ol ex ok' yuj kusk'olal yuj yahelal.
Ha heb' sik'b'ilel wuj chi', ol ex yak' b'inaj heb' ayik ol skatab'an junokxo anima heb'. Ol ex in sateli, palta ha t'a heb' in chekab' ol wak' jun ak' b'i yik syak' b'inaj heb'.

Yalnhej mach t'a jun chonhab' tik sk'an wach'ilal t'a yib'anh, a t'ayin ol sk'ana', a in Dios in swak'elk'och tas swala'. Yalnhej mach syak' sti' t'a junok tasi, a in b'i ol yak' b'inajok. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', jantak yahelal toxo ix ek'b'ati, ol b'atkan satk'olal, manhxo ol in nakoti.
Ab'ek, ol in b'o jun ak' satcha'anh yet' jun ak' yol yib'anhk'inal. Ha tastak ek'nakxo, ol b'atkan satk'olal, manhxa b'ak'inh ol nachajkotok.
Tzalajanhek t'a masanil tiempo yuj tas ol in k'ulej, yujto ol in b'oxik'e chonhab' Jerusalén b'aj ay tzalajk'olal, a heb' anima kajan ta' ol tzalaj heb' wu'uj.
Ol in tzalajpax wal yuj in chonhab' Jerusalén chi', manhxa b'ak'inh ol ab'chaj yel yaw heb' anima yuj yahelal ta'.

Malaj heb' unin jayenhej k'uhal ol ek' ta' ol chamok, malaj pax heb' icham anima manto k'och yab'ilal ol chamok. Tato ay mach scham t'a 100 ab'il sk'inal, unin animato schami. Ha mach ol chamok ayik manto k'och t'a 100 ab'il chi', a yuj schukal spet chami.
Ha heb' in chonhab' chi' ol laj sb'o spat heb', ol kajnaj heb' t'a yo'ol. Ol yawej yuwa heb', manh ch'okok mach ol loan sat.

Manhxo tonhejok ol sb'ok'e spat heb', ch'okxo mach ol aj t'a yo'ol. Manh ol yawej yawb'en heb', ch'okxopax mach ol loan sat. Ha heb' in chonhab' chi', ol najatb'ok sk'inal heb' icha sk'inal te te'. Ha heb' sik'b'ilel wu'uj chi', najtil ol yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb' yet' smunlajel.

Ha heb' in chonhab' chi', manh nab'anhejok ol munlaj heb', manh ol cham yuninal heb' wanto sk'ib'i. Yujto a in chonhab' chi', a heb' anima wak'nakkan in wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh a in Jehová in tik, a heb' ay yinhtilal heb'. Icha chi' ol aj pax heb' yuninal heb'.
Ayik manto in yawtej heb', toxo ix in tak'wi t'a heb', ayik manto lajwi yalan heb', toxo ix wab' tas syal heb'.

Ha nok' okes yet' nok' kalnel, junnhej ol wa nok'. Ha nok' choj, a anh ank'ultak ol sk'ux nok' ichok nok' wakax. Haxo nok' chan, a lum pokok ol slo nok'. Ha t'a in tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, malaj junok tas ol yal yixtani. Ha in wal swala', xchi Jehová.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha satcha'anh in despacho yaji, haxo sat lu'um tik sb'akhnub' wok yaji. Ha exxo tik, ¿b'ajtil ol he b'ok'e junok in pat b'aj wach' tzin aji?

Ha in Jehová in swala' to a in wal in b'onak juntzanh tastak ix wak' b'inaj tik, icha chi' ajnak spitzwicha'anh smasanil. Ha heb' te emnakil yaji, a in ol in tanhwej heb', haton heb' skus yuj smul, heb' ay yelk'och in lolonel t'ay.

Ay ex tzex tzalaj he k'ulan juntzanh tastak yajb'entak t'a wichanh. Yuj chi' ayik tze milancham nok' wakax silab'il t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a junok anima tze milchamok. Ayik tze milancham nok' kalnel silab'il t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a sjaj nok' tz'i' tze ch'umeli. Ayik tzeyak'an sat eyawb'en ofrenda'il t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato a schik'il nok' chitam tze tob'emi. Ayik tze nhusan incienso t'ayin, ha t'a in sat ichato ha t'a komon Dios tzeyal wach' lolonel.

Yuj chi' toxo ix in na' tas yahelal ol jawok t'a eyib'anh. Ha tas b'aj te k'un he xiwi, a chi' ol wak'kot t'ayex, yujto ix ex wawtej, palta malaj mach ix tak'wi t'ayin. Ix in lolon t'ayex, palta maj he cha eyab'i, ix he k'ulan chukal. Ix he k'ulan juntzanh tas max schalaj in k'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Ha ex tze cha eyab'i, ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ay juntzanh heb' eyetchonhab' schichon sk'ol t'ayex, tzex spechanb'eyek' heb', yujto tzeyal he b'a t'ayin, syalan heb' icha tik: Sch'oxokab' stzikikial Jehová chi', skil jab'ok he tzalaji, xchi heb'. Palta a heb' chi', te k'ixwelal ol ajkan heb', xchi Jehová.
Ab'ek jun nhilili sk'an skot t'a chonhab' chi', sk'anh skotpax t'a templo. Haton Jehová sk'anh skoti, yik syak'an spak t'a heb' ajk'ol t'a smojal.
Syalan Jehová icha tik: Ha chonhab' Sion, lajan wal icha junok ix ix mantalaj sya'il yune' skoti, tz'alji yune' ix chi'.

¿Tom ay mach ix ab'ani, mato ay mach ix ilan jun chi'? ¿Tom ay junok chonhab' junnhej k'uhal tz'och nacional? ¿Tom ay junok chonhab' junnhej k'uhal sb'o'i? Palta a Sion tik, kennhej ol yab' sya'il ol ochxok nacional.
¿Tom ol yal in yamanoch wa'an jun wan yalji, yujto a in swak' aljok? Ma'ay. Manh ol yalpaxlaj in tenanek' spitzwixi jun chonhab' tik. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in swala', icha chi' ol ajok.
Ha ex tze xajanej Jerusalén, tzalajanhek yet'ok. Ha ex ok'nak ex yuj ayik yab'annak sya'il, mol tzalajanhek yet'ok.
Yujto a Jerusalén chi', lajan icha junok ix nunab'il smontej yune', syak'an yim, icha chi' ol aj yak'an sniwanil he k'o'ol, masanto ol ex tzalaj yuj, yujto niwan wach'ilal ol scha Jerusalén chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala': Ol wak'b'at wach'ilal t'a skal heb' anima t'a jun chonhab' tik. Ol yik'kot sb'eyumal juntzanhxo nación t'ay. Icha sjawi junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ol aj sjawi. Icha junok nene' unin nib'ab'il ol ex utajok, ichato ol ex chunok, ol ex cheljok, ichato ol ex chenchenan t'a sat xub'.
Icha junok ix nunab'il smontej yune', icha chi' ol aj ex in montani. Icha chi' ol aj eyik'an sniwanil he k'ol t'a Jerusalén, xchi Jehová.

Ayik ol eyilan juntzanh tik, ol ex te tzalajok. Ol eyik'xi eyipok, icha tz'aj syaxb'ixi anh ank'ultak. Yujto ol sch'ox spoder Jehová t'a skal heb' schekab', haxo yowal sk'ol ol yak' t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay.
Yujto a Jehová ol jawok t'a kal k'ak', a scarruaje lajan icha chakxuxum ik'. Ol jawok yak'och yowal sk'ol t'a heb' ajk'ol icha sk'e nhilnhon yok te' k'ak'.
Ha yet' k'ak' yet' yespada Jehová, ol sch'olb'itej masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, tzijtum heb' ol cham yuj.

Ha wal Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios t'a skaltak te' awb'en te', stzalaj heb' sk'ulan icha sk'ulej mach skuchb'an heb', schi'an nok' chitam heb', nok' ch'o'ow yet' juntzanhxo nok' nok' yajb'entak, junnhej ol satel heb' smasanil.
Yuj tastak sna heb' yet' tastak sk'ulej heb', ol in molb'ej masanil anima t'a junjun ti'al, t'a junjun chonhab', ol in ch'oxan in poder yil heb'.

Ol in ch'oxan in poder t'a heb' olto kanok, ol in chekanb'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' tik: Haton t'a Tarsis, t'a Fut, t'a Lud b'aj kajan heb' jelan sjulwaj t'a jul-lab'. Ol in chekanpaxb'at heb' t'a Tubal, t'a Javán yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' najat t'a stitak ha' mar b'aj manh ab'chajnakok in b'inaji yet' b'aj manh ilb'ilok in poder. Ol b'at yalel yab'ixal sniwanil welk'och heb' t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi'.

Ha in Jehová in swala' to t'a masanil chonhab', ol ik'jokkot masanil heb' eyetchonhab' ayek' t'a skal heb'. Ay heb' ol ik'jokkot t'a yib'anh nok' chej, t'a yol carruaje, t'a yib'anh b'akhlab', t'a yib'anh nok' mula yet' t'a yib'anh nok' camello. Icha junok silab' ol aj sjawi heb' t'a tzalan b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin t'a Jerusalén tik. Icha tz'aj yik'ankot junok ofrenda heb' in chonhab' t'a in templo t'a yol junok yet'tal te wach', icha chi' ol aj yik'chajkot heb'.
Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' ixto kani, hata' ol in sik'el heb' ol och sacerdote'al yet' levita'il, xchi Jehová.
Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha ak' satcha'anh yet' ak' yol yib'anhk'inal ol in b'o'o, ol ajnhejek' t'a junelnhej. Icha chi' ol aj eyajnhejek'i, ol ex b'inaj yet' eyinhtilal t'a junelnhej.
Junjun sk'uhal ik'oj ip t'a junjun semana yet' juntak el tz'alji k'e'en uj, ol jawok masanil heb' anima, ol ul em kuman heb' t'ayin.

Ayik tz'elta heb' in chonhab', ol yilan sniwanil heb' chamnak heb', haton heb' pit yutejnak sb'a t'ayin. Aynhejoch nok' ha'ay schianb'at sniwanil heb' chi', haxo k'ak' wan snhusantz'a heb', malaj b'ak'inh stupi. Yajb'entak yilji heb' t'a sat masanil anima tz'ilani, xchi Jehová.
